Motivation: 现有MLLMs基准大多侧重于感知识别（recognizing what is depicted），而忽视了理解创作意图的推理能力（reasoning about why it is expressed）。艺术理解的核心在于后者，因此需要构建一个专门评估模型对创造性意图进行推理的基准。

Method: 从超过10K候选视频论文中提取专业评论与视觉演示，构建4,016个问题，涵盖电影艺术、静态视觉艺术、舞台表演艺术和游戏艺术四大领域。采用单选和可变选项多选两种题型。问题通过四阶段迭代流程生成和优化：快捷过滤、对抗性干扰、专家验证。使用零样本评估方式对28个SOTA MLLMs进行测试。

Result: 最佳模型准确率仅48.29%，人类专家准确率为87.18%，差距达38.89个百分点。表明当前SOTA MLLMs在创造性艺术理解方面存在显著不足。

Conclusion: 当前MLLMs在理解艺术创作意图方面远未达到人类专业水平，MuseBench可作为未来模型在创意领域能力提升的重要评估工具。

Abstract: Audiovisual arts encompass diverse creative disciplines, including cinema, visual arts, stage performance, and game design, where artistic meaning arises from deliberate combinations of visual, auditory, and narrative elements (e.g., fear amplified through claustrophobic framing, or grief conveyed through silence and lingering close-ups). True artistic understanding extends beyond recognizing what is depicted to reasoning about why it is expressed through particular creative choices. Despite the strong progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), this critical aspect of artistic understanding remains underexplored, as existing benchmarks largely measure perceptual recognition while overlooking reasoning about creative intent. To address this gap, we introduce Musebench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs on nuanced artistic understanding. It comprises 4,016 questions spanning cinematic arts, static visual arts, stage performing arts, and game arts, distilled from over 10K candidate video essays that pair professional commentary with visual demonstration. To capture the open-ended nature of artistic analysis at scale, the benchmark combines single-select and variable-option multi-select questions. All questions are generated and refined through a four-phase iterative pipeline combining shortcut filtering, adversarial distractors, and expert validation. Comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of 28 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that even the best-performing model achieves only 48.29% accuracy, substantially below human expert performance of 87.18%, exposing a significant gap in current models' creative domain expertise.

</details>


### [193] [Cross-Modal Iteration Distillation for Robust IHD Screening: The IDNet Framework and A New Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30027)
*Yongchang Gao,Junjie Pang,Shuaiyu Yang,Yusheng Yang,Xichao Jia,Shaojie Li,Hongfei Zhang,Jia Mu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出IDNet多模态框架，通过跨模态蒸馏聚合器（CDA）融合左右眼眼底图像与临床变量，在UK Biobank构建了包含50,410张图像的基准数据集，在缺血性心脏病筛查任务上优于多种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 眼底彩色照相（CFP）为缺血性心脏病（IHD）筛查提供低成本、非侵入性途径，但现有研究受限于公开基准稀缺以及视网膜图像与稀疏临床变量的有效融合不足。

Method: 提出IDNet多模态框架，其核心是跨模态蒸馏聚合器（CDA），使用可学习查询（learnable queries）顺序融合左眼、右眼和临床特征，缓解高维视觉特征与低维表格输入之间的不平衡。同时构建了UK Biobank基准数据集（50,410张图像，25,205名受试者），并开源了数据筛选与质量控制流程。

Result: 在构建的基准上，IDNet优于纯图像、纯临床及多种多模态基线方法；CDA作为即插即用融合模块，能持续提升多种视觉编码器的性能。

Conclusion: IDNet通过CDA模块有效实现了眼底图像与临床变量的跨模态融合，为IHD筛查提供了新的多模态框架，且CDA具有良好的通用性。

Abstract: Color Fundus Photography (CFP) offers a low-cost and non-invasive route for ischemic heart disease (IHD) screening, but current studies are limited by scarce public benchmarks and ineffective fusion of retinal images with sparse clinical variables. We propose IDNet, a multimodal framework with a Cross-Modal Distillation Aggregator (CDA) that uses learnable queries to sequentially integrate left-eye, right-eye, and clinical features, mitigating the imbalance between high-dimensional visual features and low-dimensional tabular inputs. We also construct a reproducible UK Biobank benchmark with open-source curation and quality-control pipelines, yielding 50,410 images from 25,205 subjects. On this benchmark, IDNet outperforms image-only, clinical-only, and several multimodal baselines, and CDA consistently improves multiple visual encoders as a plug-in fusion module.

</details>


### [194] [CogSENet: Blind Image Deblurring with Blur-Conditioned Semantic Routing and Explicit Frequency Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30030)
*Pan Wang,Yihao Hu,Xiujin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CogSENet，一种受鹰视觉系统启发的动态语义对齐重建框架，通过语义驱动状态空间模块（SDSSM）、双频融合块（BFFB）和连续模糊场（CBF）机制，在盲图像去模糊任务中实现了优于现有方法的视觉质量和结构保真度，并泛化至去雾、去雨和去噪任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有盲图像去模糊方法难以处理真实世界中空间变化的退化，且缺乏区分有效纹理与伪影的语义感知能力。

Method: 1) 语义驱动状态空间模块（SDSSM）：模拟鹰主动扫视扫描，通过可微分路由实现语义感知的token重组和提示条件化的长距离依赖建模；2) 双频融合块（BFFB）：模仿鹰视网膜功能分化，利用小波变换将特征分解为高低频分别处理；3) 连续模糊场（CBF）：从模糊图像估计连续模糊场并与CLIP语义先验融合，调制最深层的潜在特征以实现空间非均匀模糊的自适应恢复。

Result: 在多个去模糊基准上超越现有最先进方法，视觉质量和结构保真度均更优且参数量更少；在去雾、去雨、去噪任务上同样表现良好。

Conclusion: 生物启发的动态语义对齐框架能有效解决空间变化退化问题，并且具有良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Blind image deblurring demands the recovery of high-fidelity details and coherent structures from complex, unknown degradations. Current blind image deblurring methods struggle with real-world, spatially varying degradations, and lack the semantic awareness necessary to reliably differentiate valid textures from artifacts. To bridge this gap, we propose CogSENet, a dynamic, semantic-aligned reconstruction framework inspired by the eagle's visual system. By mimicking the eagle's active saccadic scanning, we devise a Semantic-Driven State Space Module (SDSSM) with semantic-aware token regrouping via differentiable routing, enabling prompt-conditioned long-range dependency modeling. To ensure physically interpretable recovery of textures and structures, a BiFreqFusionBlock (BFFB) mirrors functional differentiation of the eagle's retina by decomposing features into high and low frequencies using wavelet transforms. Finally, we estimate a continuous Blur Field (CBF) from blur image and fuse it with CLIP semantic priors to modulate the deepest latent features, emulating focal adaptation and enabling adaptive restoration under spatially non-uniform blur. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CogSENetoutperforms state-of-the-art deblurring methods in both visual quality and structural fidelity with fewer parameters, while also performing favorably on dehazing, deraining, and denoising tasks.

</details>


### [195] [Consensus Clustering of Free-Viewing Gaze Data: New Insights into Human-Information Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30035)
*Beryl Gnanaraj,Jaya Sreevalsan-Nair,Saqib Alam Ansari,Maanasa Rajaraman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了EnsembleGaze，一种用于自由观看眼动数据共识聚类的端到端无监督集成学习系统。通过对用户和刺激特征分别进行共识聚类，并进一步提出共识子空间聚类和谱双聚类两种高维策略，系统揭示了图像分组呈现稳健的"环境-焦点"观看模式区分，而用户分组则依赖于图像上下文，仅双聚类和两步条件方法能恢复该结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由观看眼动数据虽然丰富，但其人机交互模式（HII）尚未得到充分研究。现有探索性数据分析仅能提供注视点和兴趣区等基本注意力模式，缺乏对用户行为和刺激类型联合表征的深入理解。

Method: 提出端到端无监督集成学习系统EnsembleGaze：1) 基于统计描述符对注视分布进行特征工程提取；2) 对特征向量实施多种聚类方法的共识投票，计算共关联矩阵；3) 分别对用户和刺激进行共识聚类作为基线；4) 提出两种高维聚类策略——共识子空间聚类和谱双聚类，实现用户与图像的联合表征。

Result: 图像刺激分组在不同方法间高度一致，呈现出稳健的"环境-焦点"观看模式区分；用户分组则具有图像上下文依赖性，仅双聚类和两步条件方法能有效恢复该结构。在公开数据集上的测试揭示了数据集特定的模式，不同聚类策略提供互补性洞察。

Conclusion: EnsembleGaze为场景感知研究中注视行为的无监督分析提供了一种可复现的方法，能够有效揭示自由观看眼动数据中的人机交互模式，特别是环境与焦点观看模式的区别以及用户行为的图像上下文依赖性。

Abstract: Free-viewing gaze data provides a rich, task-free window into human visual attention. Conventional exploratory data analysis of the data provides user attention patterns through fixations and areas of interest. However, despite the richness of this gaze data, its human-information interaction (HII) patterns are understudied. We address this gap using consensus clustering of gaze data with respect to users and stimulus characteristics. We present a novel end-to-end unsupervised ensemble learning system for consensus clustering of free-viewing gaze datasets, EnsembleGaze. With a goal of characterizing the user behavior and stimulus type, we propose a feature engineering step based on statistical descriptors of fixation-based distributions. EnsembleGaze involves consensus voting of selected clustering methods implemented on the feature vector to compute the co-association matrix. Using the separate consensus clustering of users and stimuli as a baseline, we further propose two high-dimensional clustering strategies for determining gaze clusters based on joint user and image characterization. They are consensus subspace clustering and spectral biclustering. Clustering performance is evaluated using selected standard metrics and is further interpreted through image-level properties. Our system provides a replicable method for the unsupervised analysis of fixation behavior in scene perception research. Our results show that image stimuli groupings are highly consistent across methods, reflecting a robust ambient-versus-focal viewing mode distinction, whereas user groupings are image-context-dependent, a structure that only biclustering and the two-step conditional approaches are architecturally capable of recovering. Testing on the publicly available datasets revealed dataset-specific patterns, with each offering complementary insights through distinct clustering strategies.

</details>


### [196] [Walking in the Implicit: Interactive World Exploration via Neural Scene Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30045)
*Zhiqi Li,Chengrui Dong,Zhenhua Du,Hangning Zhou,Cong Qiu,Hailong Qin,Mu Yang,Dongxu Wei,Peidong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于神经隐式场景（NIS）的交互式视频生成范式，将传统逐帧隐变量滚动生成解耦为紧凑场景状态的随机转移和姿态条件渲染，NeuWorld实例化该范式，在无预训练视频骨干或3D重建器情况下实现长程一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交互式视频生成系统将帧隐变量的状态转移与高频观测合成纠缠在一起，导致长程一致性和生成效率受限。

Method: 提出Walking in the Implicit场景中心范式，将生成分解为两个解耦过程：(1) 随机状态转移——采用扩散Transformer在紧凑的神经隐式场景（NIS）上演化；(2) 确定性渲染——基于采样场景状态进行姿态条件渲染。NeuWorld通过变换器VAE从稀疏姿态帧学习局部锚定的NIS，复用VAE编码器作为统一条件器，将相机、参考图像和历史线索映射到同一NIS模态。

Result: 在公开姿态视图数据上从头训练，无需预训练视频骨干或辅助3D重建器，实现了强长程一致性和良好的推理效率。

Conclusion: 场景中心范式通过状态与渲染的解耦，有效解决了交互式视频生成中的长程一致性问题，且模型设计简洁高效。

Abstract: Interactive video generation systems for camera-controlled world exploration roll out growing sequences of latent video frames, entangling state transition with high-frequency observation synthesis. We propose Walking in the Implicit, a scene-centric paradigm that changes the rollout variable from frame latents to a fixed-length, renderable implicit state, termed Neural Implicit Scene (NIS). This factorizes interactive generation into stochastic transition of a compact scene state and deterministic pose-conditioned rendering given the sampled state. We instantiate this paradigm as NeuWorld: a transformer VAE learns locally anchored NIS from sparse posed frames, and a diffusion transformer evolves NIS conditioned on future camera trajectories and geometry-aware retrieved history. By reusing the VAE encoder as a unified conditioner, NeuWorld maps camera, reference-image, and history cues into the same NIS modality, avoiding external heterogeneous encoders. Trained from scratch on public posed-view data without pretrained video backbones or auxiliary 3D reconstructors, NeuWorld achieves strong long-horizon consistency with favorable inference efficiency.

</details>


### [197] [Hyper-Network Neural Functional Maps for Unsupervised Robust 3D Shape Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30131)
*Dongliang Cao,Florian Bernard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种超网络（hyper-network）预测非线性神经功能映射（NFM），通过MLP和跳跃连接改进标准功能映射，以无监督方式更好地对齐光谱基，显著提升在部分性、拓扑噪声和原始点云等挑战场景下的形状匹配精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非刚性3D形状匹配方法在处理部分性、拓扑噪声和原始点云等挑战场景时表现不佳，其根本瓶颈在于显著的内在畸变使得截断光谱基无法通过线性变换（即功能映射）准确对齐。

Method: 将NFM建模为带有跳跃连接的MLP，用于精炼标准FM；使用超网络预测该MLP的权重，并以标准FM为条件；通过新颖的无监督光谱对齐损失进行训练。

Result: 该方法可无缝集成到现有最先进的无监督深度功能映射管线中，在挑战性场景下显著提升匹配精度。

Conclusion: 非线性神经功能映射（NFM）相比传统线性功能映射能更好应对内在畸变，是提升非刚性形状匹配鲁棒性的有效方法。

Abstract: Functional maps are the cornerstone of recent non-rigid 3D shape matching methods due to their efficiency and performance. However, existing methods struggle with challenging scenarios, such as partiality, topological noise, and raw point clouds. A primary bottleneck is that significant intrinsic distortion prevents truncated spectral bases from being accurately aligned via linear transformations (i.e., functional maps). To address this, we introduce a hyper-network that predicts non-linear neural functional maps (NFM), learned in an unsupervised manner, to better align spectral bases. Specifically, we model the NFM as an MLP with skip-connection to refine standard FM and employ a hyper-network to predict its weights, conditioned on standard FM. Our framework is trained using a novel unsupervised spectral alignment loss. Experiments demonstrate that our approach can be seamlessly integrated into state-of-the-art unsupervised deep functional map pipelines, substantially improving matching accuracy in demanding scenarios.

</details>


### [198] [Argus: Metric Panoramic 3D Reconstruction for Indoor Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30047)
*Xi Li,Linyuan Li,Yan Wu,Tong Rao,Kai Zhang,Xinchen Hui,Cihui Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Realsee3D混合数据集（10K室内场景，299K全景视角）和基于该数据集训练的Argus前馈网络，用于公制全景3D重建。Argus通过可学习的共视模块选择最优参考视图解决全局位姿漂移问题，并通过分解双向像素到世界映射为可解释子步骤来增强多任务学习的几何一致性，在相机位姿估计、深度估计和点云重建任务上达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前全景数据的公制前馈3D重建领域研究不足，主要缺乏大规模带公制度量的全景RGB-D训练数据。

Method: 1) 构建Realsee3D混合数据集（1K真实+9K合成室内场景，299K全景视角，带公制度量标注）；2) 提出Argus前馈网络，包含可学习的共视模块选择几何最优参考视图锚定公制世界坐标系；3) 将双向像素到世界映射分解为可解释子步骤，引入逐步骤监督和跨坐标联合约束以增强几何一致性。

Result: 在Realsee3D基准上，Argus在相机位姿估计、深度估计和点云重建任务上均达到最先进的公制性能。

Conclusion: 结合大规模混合数据集和创新的网络设计（共视模块选择+分解映射子步骤），能够有效解决稀疏无序全景数据中的全局位姿漂移问题，实现高质量的公制3D重建。

Abstract: Metric feed-forward 3D reconstruction for panoramic data remains under-explored due to the lack of large-scale panoramic RGB-D training data.
  We present Realsee3D, a hybrid dataset of 10K indoor scenes (1K real, 9K synthetic) with 299K panoramic viewpoints and precise metric annotations,
  and Argus, a feed-forward network trained on it for metric panoramic 3D reconstruction.
  In the sparse unordered capture setting of Realsee3D,
  a poorly chosen coordinate anchor can cause global pose drift.
  Argus addresses this with a learned covisibility module that selects the geometrically optimal reference view to anchor the metric world frame.
  To further improve multi-task learning,
  we decompose the bidirectional pixel-to-world mapping into interpretable sub-steps with per-step supervision and cross-coordinate joint constraints,
  reinforcing geometric consistency across prediction branches.
  On the Realsee3D benchmark,
  Argus achieves state-of-the-art metric performance in camera pose estimation, depth estimation, and point cloud reconstruction.
  Project page: https://argus-paper.realsee.ai.

</details>


### [199] [Bridging the Gap Between Image Restoration and Navigational Safety in Hazy Conditions: A New Visibility Estimation Metric for Maritime Surveillance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30049)
*Wentao Feng,Guobei Peng,Wengang Mao,Ryan Wen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对雾霾条件下海上能见度距离评估问题，提出了一种面向能见度的去雾评估框架。通过构建基于Unity3D的海上模拟能见度数据集（MSVD），并利用目标检测精度作为中间指标，建立了去雾性能与可视距离估计之间的可解释映射关系，实现了对航行安全可操作性的量化评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图像质量评估指标（如PSNR、SSIM、FSIM、FADE、NIQE）无法建立图像恢复质量与实际能见度阈值之间的物理可解释关系，难以直接评估雾霾对航行安全的影响。

Method: 1) 使用Unity3D构建海上模拟能见度数据集（MSVD），包含分级能见度条件下的成对雾图与清晰图，具备精确能见度标注；2) 提出以目标检测精度为中间指标的去雾能见度评估度量，建立能见度距离与检测性能之间的映射关系，将图像恢复改善转化为可量化的能见度增益。

Result: 实验结果表明：MSVD为分级能见度下去雾性能评估提供了可靠基准；所提度量实现了可解释且可靠的可视距离估计，支持航行安全与操作效率的评估。

Conclusion: 该工作将去雾性能评估从单纯的图像质量维度提升至航行安全操作维度，为海事领域能见度相关安全性评估提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Visibility distance is critical to maritime navigational safety because it determines the effective observation range of shipborne and shore-based monitoring systems. Under hazy conditions, degraded visual information shortens observable distance and increases navigational risks and economic losses. Although numerous image dehazing methods have been developed, conventional image quality assessment metrics, such as PSNR, SSIM, FSIM, FADE, and NIQE, cannot establish a physically interpretable relationship between restoration quality and practical visibility thresholds. To address this limitation, this work proposes a visibility-oriented evaluation framework that links dehazing performance with visible-distance estimation. First, a Maritime Simulated Visibility Dataset (MSVD) is constructed using Unity3D to simulate maritime traffic scenes under graded visibility conditions. The dataset provides paired hazy and clear images with precise visibility annotations, enabling quantitative analysis of visibility restoration. Second, a dehazing visibility evaluation metric is developed by using object detection accuracy as an intermediate indicator. By establishing a mapping between visibility distance and detection performance, the proposed metric converts image restoration improvements into measurable visibility gains. Six representative dehazing methods are evaluated using both conventional image quality metrics and the proposed visibility metric. Experimental results under different imaging conditions demonstrate that MSVD provides a reliable benchmark for evaluating dehazing performance across graded visibility levels, while the proposed metric enables interpretable and reliable visible-distance estimation, thereby supporting the assessment of navigational safety and operational efficiency.

</details>


### [200] [Few-Shot Domain Incremental Learning via Continual Vision-Language Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30190)
*Naeem Paeedeh,Mahardhika Pratama,Wolfgang Mayer,Mukesh Prasad,Weiping Ding,Yew-Soon Ong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了少样本域增量学习（FSDIL）这一新问题，并设计了基于视觉-语言联合巩固（CVLC）的算法，通过基域潜在空间保留和双联合投影（DCP）参数高效微调，在数据稀缺场景下实现域增量学习，在多个基准上相较现有方法提升高达16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有域增量学习（DIL）方法在数据稀缺时面临过拟合问题，而现实场景中常常难以获取大量标注数据。本文旨在解决极端数据短缺条件下的域增量学习问题，填补少样本域增量学习（FSDIL）的研究空白。

Method: 提出Continual Vision-Language Consolidation (CVLC)算法，核心包括：(1) 基域潜在空间保留；(2) 视觉原型校准与通过LLM生成多模板和同义词诱导语言原型，并融合视觉-语言原型；(3) 双联合投影（DCP）作为参数高效微调方法，适应新域；(4) 共享与域特定组件相结合的结构设计。

Result: 在多个基准问题上的实验表明，CVLC算法相较现有方法性能提升高达16%。

Conclusion: 本文提出的CVLC算法有效解决了少样本域增量学习问题，通过视觉-语言联合建模和参数高效微调，在数据稀缺场景下实现了优越的域增量学习性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Existing domain-incremental learning (DIL) strategies call for massive amounts of data to adapt to new domains and suffer from the overfitting problem in the case of data scarcity. This paper puts forward a relatively uncharted problem, namely, few-shot domain incremental learning (FSDIL), taking into account the problem of extreme data shortages in the realm of DIL. A novel algorithm, namely Continual Vision-Language Consolidation (CVLC), is proposed to address the FSDIL problem, where the key idea lies in the concept of latent space reservation in the base domain coupled with dual coalescent projection (DCP) as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method. First, the vision prototype is calibrated while multiple templates and synonyms are generated via LLMs to induce the language prototype. The vision and language prototypes are fused. Adaptation to never-ending arrivals of new domains is done by the DCP technique, fine-tuned in such a way to prepare the model to unseen domains via latent-space reservations committed in the base domain. CVLC is structured under shared and domain-specific components to combine general knowledge and domain-specific details. The advantage of our approach is demonstrated through a range of benchmark problems and comparisons with prior arts, in which CVLC outperforms them by up to a 16% gap. Our codes are shared publicly in https://github.com/Naeem-Paeedeh/CVLC .

</details>


### [201] [Illuminating Unified Multimodal Model for Free-form Interleaved Text-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30054)
*Chonghuinan Wang,Zhikai Chen,Chunwei Wang,Yecong Wan,Junwei Yang,Zhixin Wang,Wei Zhang,Jiaqi Xu,Renjing Pei,Xiaohe Wu,Fan Li,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ILLUME-X 是一个统一的跨模态生成框架，通过改进数据效率、渐进式训练策略和专用评估方法，在自由格式交错文本-图像生成任务上显著超越先前模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推进多模态智能到下一阶段，使模型能够自主生成自由格式的交错文本-图像序列，解决现有模型在跨模态数据效率和训练稳定性方面的不足。

Method: 包含三个核心组件：(i) 扩展的训练数据管道优化交错文本-图像生成；(ii) 带有自适应目标的渐进式训练策略，适用于任意长度的多模态token序列；(iii) 针对交错文本-图像序列的客观综合评估方法 ILScore。

Result: ILLUME-X 在风格迁移、图像分解和故事叙述等多个交错文本-图像生成任务上优于之前的统一模型。

Conclusion: ILLUME-X 通过提升数据效率和稳定多模态训练过程，实现了高质量的自由格式交错文本-图像生成，为多模态智能提供了先进统一的范式。

Abstract: The advancement of generative AI models capable of producing text and image marks a critical step forward in the realm of multimodal intelligence, particularly for tasks involving the interleaving of both modalities. To advance this intelligence to the next stage, it is crucial for models to autonomously generate free-form interleaved text-image sequences. In this paper, we introduce ILLUME-X, an advanced unified multimodal paradigm that enables high-quality, free-form interleaved text-image generation by improving multimodal data efficiency and stabilizing the multimodal training process. ILLUME-X comprises three key components: (i) an expanded training data pipeline optimized for interleaved text-image generation, (ii) a progressive training strategy with self-adaptive objectives for free-length multimodal token sequences, and (iii) an objective and comprehensive evaluation method ILScore for interleaved text-image sequences. Notably, our ILLUME-X outperforms previous unified models across multiple interleaved text-image generation tasks like style transfer, image decomposition and storytelling.

</details>


### [202] [Emergence of a Shared Canonical Object Frame from In-the-Wild Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30058)
*Tom Fischer,Martin Sundermeyer,Adam Kortylewski,Eddy Ilg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督方法，仅利用野外目标中心视频和SfM噪声相机位姿，通过共享粗规范网格的几何瓶颈，无需任何规范姿态标签或类别条件，即可从多视图一致性和特征提取器的语义先验中自动涌现出共享规范坐标系，在类别级姿态估计基准上达到与依赖规范姿态监督的方法相当的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法建立共享规范坐标系需要人工标注，这成为规模化瓶颈，限制了类别和实例的多样性。本文旨在消除这一人工依赖，让规范坐标系能够从自监督训练中自动涌现。

Method: 核心思路是所有训练序列通过一个共享几何瓶颈——粗规范网格（不携带类别细节）进行路由。通过学习图像像素到该网格的密集对应关系，并利用噪声SfM几何估计每序列的对齐，规范坐标系从多视图一致性和特征提取器的语义先验中自动涌现，无需规范姿态标签或类别条件。在16万野外目标视频上进行自监督训练。

Result: 在类别级姿态估计基准上，该方法达到了与依赖规范姿态监督的方法相当的竞争性精度。

Conclusion: 仅通过自监督学习和共享几何瓶颈，无需任何规范姿态标注或类别条件，即可从野外视频中自动学习到共享规范坐标系，有效解决了标注瓶颈问题。

Abstract: Comparing object orientations and positions across different instances requires their poses to be expressed in a shared canonical frame. Establishing such frames has traditionally required manual annotation, creating a scaling bottleneck that limits category and instance diversity. We show that a shared canonical frame can instead emerge from self-supervised training on object-centric videos captured in the wild, using only noisy camera poses from Structure-from-Motion. Our key idea is to route all training sequences through a shared geometric bottleneck: a coarse canonical mesh that carries no category-specific detail. By learning dense correspondences from image pixels to this mesh, and estimating per-sequence alignments from noisy SfM geometry, a common canonical frame emerges from multi-view consistency and the semantic priors of the feature extractor, without any canonical pose labels or category conditioning. Trained in a self-supervised manner on 160,000 in-the-wild object videos, our method achieves competitive accuracy on category-level pose estimation benchmarks compared to methods that rely on canonical pose supervision. The code and checkpoint is available on https://github.com/Fischer-Tom/Emergent-Canonical-Frame/.

</details>


### [203] [A Multi Center Breast FNAC Whole-Slide Cytology Dataset for AI-Assisted Patch-Wise Classification Using C1 to C5 Reporting Categories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30209)
*Garima Jain,Abhijeet Patil,Surabhi Jain,Sanghamitra Pati,Amit Sethi,Sandeep Mathur,Pulkit Verma,Nishi Halduniya,Jatin Kashyap,Sharat Kumar,Simmi Kharb,Sunita Singh,Sucheta Devi Khuraijam,Sushma Khuraijam,Ratan Konjengbam,Arvind Kumar,Deepali Tirkey,Saurav Banerjee,Shivani Kalhan,Rakesh Kumar Gupta,Ranjana Solanki,Deepika Hemranjani,Shashank Nath Singh,Uma Handa,Manveen Kaur,B. G. Malathi,Yogender P.,Niraj Kumari,Shruti Gupta,Indu R. Nair,Vidya C.,Basumitra Das,Sunil Kumar Komanapalli,Ravindra Karle,Tanaya Kulkarni,Vandana Raphael,Biswajit Dey,Vaishali Gaikwad,Nilam Adhav*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个多中心乳腺细针穿刺细胞学(FNAC)数据集，包含321名患者、470张全切片图像(WSI)，使用C1至C5报告标签进行分块分类，数据集约950GB，通过Zenodo公开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为乳腺FNAC的补丁级分类提供标准化的多中心数据集，支持C1至C5报告标签的自动分类研究，填补该领域公开数据集的空白。

Method: 从印度多家三级医疗中心前瞻性收集321名患者的470张WSI，采用Papanicolaou(190张)或MayGrunwald Giemsa(280张)染色，Hamamatsu NanoZoomer S360以40X放大、0.25微米/像素扫描，存储为NDPI格式。其中446张WSI包含标注的补丁区域，生成7,398个PNG图像补丁并附有专家验证的C1至C5标签。

Result: 构建了一个约950GB的完整数据集，包括NDPI格式的WSI、WSI级别的GeoJSON标注文件、提取的补丁图像、去标识化元数据、数据字典、验证摘要、WSI与Zenodo记录的关联清单，以及数据集检查和复用的代码。

Conclusion: 该数据集为乳腺FNAC的C1-C5分类研究提供了大规模、多中心、标准化的公开资源，有利于推动计算机辅助诊断在该领域的应用。

Abstract: We present a multi center breast fine needle aspiration cytology (FNAC) dataset designed for patch wise classification using C1 to C5 reporting labels. The prospective dataset includes 321 patients and 470 whole-slide images (WSIs) collected from participating tertiary medical centers in India between May 2023 and March 2026. Slides were stained using Papanicolaou (190 WSIs) or MayGrunwald Giemsa (280 WSIs), scanned on a Hamamatsu NanoZoomer S360 at 40X magnification and 0.25 microns per pixel, and stored directly in NDPI format. Across the 470 WSIs, 446 WSIs contain annotated patch regions, yielding 7,398 PNG image patches with expert-verified C1 to C5 labels. The release includes NDPI WSIs, WSI-level GeoJSON annotation files, extracted patch images, deidentified metadata, a data dictionary, a validation summary, a manifest linking WSIs to Zenodo records, and code for dataset inspection and reuse. The complete dataset is approximately 950 GB and is available through Zenodo.

</details>


### [204] [Clinical Risk-Aware Multi-Level Grading for Coronary Artery Stenosis through Curved Feature Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30082)
*Shishuang Zhao,Hongtai Li,Junjie Hou,Yuhang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于双模态融合（CCTA+3D SCPR）和临床风险感知损失的多级冠状动脉狭窄分级模型，通过曲线特征重建模块对齐特征，显著提升了分级性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发有效的多级冠状动脉狭窄分级模型对冠心病诊断具有重要临床意义，但现有基于单一模态（CCTA或3D SCPR）的方法存在固有缺陷：CCTA因血管路径迂曲难以分析，3D SCPR易出现异常扭曲影响准确分级；此外，不同狭窄等级对应的临床风险差异难以融入算法设计。

Method: 1) 提出曲线特征重建（CFR）模块，以血管曲线为先验，通过逐点对应策略精确对齐并融合3D SCPR和CCTA双模态特征；2) 设计临床风险感知（CR）损失函数，将临床风险相关性引入网络训练过程。

Result: 在内部数据集上的实验结果显示，所提方法显著优于其他对比方法，多项消融实验也验证了各设计组件的有效性。

Conclusion: 双模态融合结合临床风险感知损失能有效提升冠状动脉狭窄多级分级的准确性，使算法更好地与临床诊断对齐。

Abstract: Developing a multi-level grading model for coronary artery stenosis holds great clinical significance for the diagnosis of coronary artery disease. However, designing an effective multi-level deep learning algorithm faces significant challenges. Specifically, utilizing CCTA or 3D SCPR images alone presents inherent shortcomings: CCTA images are difficult to analyze due to the tortuous paths of blood vessels, while 3D SCPR images are prone to abnormal distortions that hinder accurate grading. Furthermore, different stenosis grades are associated with varying clinical risks, and incorporating this association into the algorithm is non-trivial. To address the former problems, we propose the Curved Feature Reconstruction (CFR) module, which uses vessel curves as prior and employs a point-by-point correspondence strategy to precisely align and fuse features from both 3D SCPR and CCTA images. Meanwhile, a Clinical Risk-Aware (CR) Loss is employed to introduce clinical risk relevance into the network training so that the algorithm can better align with the clinical diagnosis. The experimental results on a in-house dataset reveal that our approach significantly outperforms other methods, and several ablation studies also demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed designs.

</details>


### [205] [Efficient RGB-T Object Detection via Sparse Cross-Modality Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30215)
*Chao Tian,Zikun Zhou,Chao Yang,Guoqing Zhu,Zhenyu He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种稀疏融合机制用于RGB-T目标检测，通过两阶段框架（先轻量级单模态检测生成RoI，再对稀疏候选区域进行跨模态融合），在保持检测精度的同时大幅降低计算开销，并在高分辨率图像上展现出良好的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RGB-T检测器多采用重型双骨干网络和全图密集跨模态融合，计算成本过高；而实际场景中大部分区域为平滑背景，单模态模型即可轻松处理，无需对所有区域进行复杂的跨模态融合。

Method: 提出两阶段稀疏融合框架：第一阶段使用轻量级单模态检测器快速生成高召回率的候选区域（RoI）；第二阶段仅对稀疏的候选区域进行跨模态特征融合，以滤除误检并精修边界框，从而将计算资源自适应地集中于潜在前景区域。

Result: 在多个RGB-T检测基准上，该方法以显著更少的参数量和更低的计算成本取得了与现有方法竞争的性能，并具备良好的高分辨率图像可扩展性。

Conclusion: 通过稀疏融合机制，可以在显著降低计算开销的同时保持RGB-T检测的准确率，验证了"大部分背景区域无需复杂跨模态融合"这一观察的有效性。

Abstract: RGB-T detectors leverage the complementary strengths of visible and thermal infrared modalities, achieving robust performance under challenging conditions. Many of them resort to heavy dual backbones and exhaustive cross-modality fusion across the entire image, leading to impractically high computational costs. We observe that most image regions are smooth backgrounds (e.g., sky, ground) that can be easily handled by lightweight single-modality models. In light of this observation, we propose a sparse fusion mechanism for efficient RGB-T detection: first rapidly scanning the image to identify the proposals and then carefully examining the remaining sparse proposals via feature fusion. We propose a two-stage framework to instantiate this mechanism, which performs detection in two stages: 1) a lightweight and modality-specific detection stage that produces high-recall RoIs, and 2) a fusion-driven examination and refinement stage that filters out the false positives and refines the bounding boxes. This design enables the detector to adaptively allocate more computational resources to the potential foregrounds, improving the efficiency while ensuring detection accuracy. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves competitive performance with substantially fewer parameters and lower cost, while maintaining strong scalability to high-resolution images.

</details>


### [206] [One Forward Beats Two: InnerZoom for Accurate and Efficient GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30084)
*Chen Liu,Ling Chen,Hanzhang Zhou,Liangyu Chen,Chenglin Cai,Xin Yu,Steven Hoi,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InnerZoom提出了一种单前向传播的跨层证据桥接框架，通过压缩、保留和重新注入跨层证据状态，在不增加额外计算开销的情况下，实现了与两阶段ZoomIn方法相当的GUI grounding精度，在6个基准上达到SOTA，同时降低延迟31.8%、计算量29%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM-based GUI grounding方法采用自回归坐标生成方式，但在解码过程中，中间层的目标区域感知信息既未保留也未传递到最终坐标预测中。ZoomIn-style方法通过外部裁剪-重运行流程提升定位精度，但增加了端到端延迟和计算成本。因此，本文旨在保留两阶段方法的精度优势，同时避免额外计算开销。

Method: InnerZoom是一个单前向传播的跨层证据桥接框架。首先将原始前向传播中与目标相关的线索压缩为紧凑的跨层证据状态，然后在后续解码层中对该状态进行保留、精炼和重新注入，以引导坐标预测。

Result: InnerZoom-4B在6个GUI grounding基准上均达到SOTA：OSWorld-G 64.7、UI-Vision 40.2、OSWorld-GR 73.1、MMBench-GUI 87.6，分别超过此前最优结果4.1、3.2、2.9、2.3点。在4B可控设置下，相比SFT+RL基线平均提升5.3点，超过两阶段ZoomIn方法1.3点，同时端到端延迟降低31.8%，TFLOPs减少约29%。

Conclusion: InnerZoom通过跨层证据桥接机制，在不引入额外前向传播的情况下，有效解决了MLLM在GUI grounding中中间层感知信息丢失的问题，实现了精度与效率的双重提升。

Abstract: MLLM-based GUI grounding methods commonly formulate target localization as autoregressive coordinate generation, enabling models to leverage the strong instruction-following and semantic understanding capabilities of MLLMs. However, this formulation requires the model to retain region-level target evidence while decoding coordinate tokens with the spatial precision demanded by GUI clicking. Our diagnostic analysis reveals that target-region awareness emerges in intermediate decoder layers but is neither retained nor translated into the final coordinate prediction. Existing ZoomIn-style methods address this issue through an external crop-and-rerun pass, which improves localization but increases end-to-end latency and computational cost. To retain the accuracy benefits of two-pass zooming without this extra cost, we propose InnerZoom, a single-forward framework for cross-layer evidence bridging. InnerZoom transforms target-related cues from the original forward pass into a compact cross-layer evidence state, then preserves, refines, and reinjects this state throughout later decoding layers to guide coordinate prediction. Extensive experimental results suggest that InnerZoom-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance on all six GUI grounding benchmarks, obtaining 64.7 on OSWorld-G, 40.2 on UI-Vision, 73.1 on OSWorld-GR, and 87.6 on MMBench-GUI, surpassing the previous best results by 4.1, 3.2, 2.9, and 2.3 points, respectively. Under a controlled 4B setting, InnerZoom improves the same SFT+RL baseline by 5.3 points on average and outperforms two-pass ZoomIn by 1.3 points on average, while reducing end-to-end latency by up to 31.8% and TFLOPs by about 29%. Code and models will be publicly available.

</details>


### [207] [Early Cue Precision Shapes Visual Shortcut Learning in Controlled Cue-Manipulation Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30344)
*Chanho Park,Woochan Lee,Janyeong Oh,Geongho Gong,Minshu Kim,Yeachan Kwak,Seongim Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉分类器在依赖低级线索（如纹理）时，面对冲突或抑制条件下的失败机制。通过一系列合成和自然图像实验，发现早期线索精度（低级线索预测标签的可靠性）会显著影响模型在冲突条件下的表现，且线索退化不能替代线索去相关；只有在下游适配过程中持续维护线索去相关，才能防止捷径学习覆盖早期训练带来的鲁棒性收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉分类器在匹配分布上能取得高精度，但常依赖低级线索（如纹理），这些线索在冲突或抑制条件下会导致性能崩溃。作者希望探究这种失败是否受早期线索精度（即低级线索在早期学习或下游探针拟合中预测标签的可靠性）的影响。

Method: 在合成形状-纹理任务、序列数字训练、10类冻结表示审计以及基于CIFAR-10自然图像的纹理覆盖基准上，操纵对象-纹理匹配概率，评估匹配ID精度、冲突精度、纹理选择率和抑制行为。考察了不同纹理覆盖强度（alpha ∈ {0.15,0.25,0.35,0.50}）下的表现，并对比了端到端训练与微调的效果。

Result: 退化但具有预测性的输入不能替代线索去相关。在10类数字探针中，冲突精度从机会水平线索精度下的0.589下降到目标完美纹理下的0.005。在CIFAR-10冻结探针中，冲突精度从0.569下降到0.114，纹理选择率从0.049上升到0.855。端到端CIFAR-10训练表明，低早期线索精度能改善预目标冲突行为，但富含捷径的微调可迅速覆盖这一收益。

Conclusion: 线索去相关必须在下游适配过程中持续维护，而不能仅仅作为一次性接种处理。

Abstract: Visual classifiers can achieve high matched-distribution accuracy while relying on low-level cues that fail under conflict or suppression. We test whether this failure is shaped by early cue precision: the reliability with which a low-level cue predicts the label during early learning or downstream probe fitting. Across synthetic shape-texture tasks, sequential digit training, a 10-class frozen-representation audit, and a CIFAR-10 natural-image-based texture-overlay benchmark, we manipulate object-texture match probability and evaluate matched-ID accuracy, conflict accuracy, texture-choice rate, and suppression behavior. Degraded-but-predictive input does not substitute for cue decorrelation. In 10-class digit probes, conflict accuracy drops from 0.589 under chance-like cue precision to 0.005 under target-perfect texture. In CIFAR-10 frozen probes, conflict accuracy drops from 0.569 to 0.114, while texture choice rises from 0.049 to 0.855; this ordering persists across texture-overlay strengths alpha in {0.15,0.25,0.35,0.50}. End-to-end CIFAR-10 training shows that low early cue precision improves pre-target conflict behavior, but shortcut-rich fine-tuning can rapidly overwrite this benefit. Cue decorrelation must therefore be maintained during downstream adaptation rather than treated as a one-time inoculation.

</details>


### [208] [CylindTrack: Depth-Aware Cylindrical Motion Modeling for Panoramic Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30097)
*Buyin Deng,Kai Luo,Lingxin Huang,Xinqi Liu,Fei Cheng,Hang Zheng,Liming Yin,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CylindTrack提出了一种基于深度感知的圆柱形跟踪-by-检测框架，用于全景多目标跟踪。通过深度-时间轨迹建模、球面时空一致性学习和拓扑感知圆柱运动模型，解决了全景视频中周期性水平域、大视场深度不稳定和身份保持等挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景摄像头具有360°视野，能减少盲区并延长目标观测时长，但全景MOT并非透视MOT的简单扩展：全景视频的水平图像域是周期性的而非欧几里得的，这破坏了平面运动假设，使得基于IoU的关联在0°/360°接缝附近不可靠；同时，大视场场景包含更多目标、更强的尺度变化和更频繁的交互，使得在线关联对不稳定的逐帧深度线索特别敏感。

Method: 1) 深度-时间轨迹建模(DTM)：将实例深度从孤立的逐帧线索提升为时间滤波后的轨迹级状态；2) 球面时空一致性学习(SSTC)：结合时间混合器和球面几何感知注意力，增强深度感知表示中的时间一致性和全景几何对齐；3) 拓扑感知圆柱运动模型(TCMM)：将水平运动提升到连续的角状态空间，在周期性全景域中执行接缝一致的运动预测和关联。

Result: 通过联合建模轨迹级深度一致性和全景拓扑，CylindTrack在挑战性的全景场景中改善了身份保持和轨迹连续性。

Conclusion: CylindTrack通过深度-时间轨迹建模、球面时空一致性学习和拓扑感知圆柱运动模型，有效解决了全景多目标跟踪中的周期性域问题、深度不稳定性和关联可靠性挑战，提升了全景场景下的跟踪性能。

Abstract: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) is a core capability for embodied perception, and panoramic cameras are attractive for embodied systems because their 360° field of view reduces blind spots and keeps surrounding targets observable for longer durations. However, panoramic MOT is not a straightforward extension of perspective MOT. In equirectangular panoramic videos, the horizontal image domain is periodic rather than Euclidean, which breaks planar motion assumptions and makes IoU-based association unreliable near the 0°/360° seam. Meanwhile, large-FoV scenes often contain more objects, stronger scale variation, and more frequent interactions, making online association particularly sensitive to unstable frame-wise depth cues. To address these issues, we propose CylindTrack, a depth-aware cylindrical tracking-by-detection framework for panoramic MOT. CylindTrack first introduces Depth-Temporal Trajectory Modeling (DTM), which promotes instance depth from an isolated frame-wise cue to a temporally filtered trajectory-level state. To improve the reliability of depth observations, we further develop Spherical Spatio-Temporal Consistency Learning (SSTC), which combines a Temporal Mixer and Spherical Geometry-aware Attention to enhance temporal coherence and panoramic geometric alignment in depth-aware representations. Finally, we design a Topology-Aware Cylindrical Motion Model (TCMM) that lifts horizontal motion into a continuous angular state space and performs seam-consistent motion prediction and association in the periodic panoramic domain. By jointly modeling trajectory-level depth consistency and panoramic topology, CylindTrack improves identity preservation and trajectory continuity in challenging panoramic scenes. The source code will be released at https://github.com/warriordby/CylindTrack.

</details>


### [209] [FFAvatar: Feed-Forward 4D Head Avatar Reconstruction from Sparse Portrait Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30347)
*Jianjiang Yao,Ke Xian,Renxiang Dai,Robert Caiming Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FFAvatar 提出了一种基于Transformer的3D高斯框架，能够从一张或多张参考肖像图像快速构建高质量、可动画的4D头部化身。该方法支持增量式重建，通过交替注意力机制解耦身份外观与表情/视角变化，采用稀疏到密集的学习范式平衡保真度与效率，并引入运动细化模块实现主体特定的动态个性化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈式方法需要固定数量的输入视角，缺乏灵活性和增量重建能力，且在身份一致性、表达驱动的灵活性和重建效率方面存在不足。

Method: 1) 交替注意力机制解耦身份外观与表情、视角变化；2) 稀疏到密集的学习范式：先基于FLAME顶点学习稀疏粗粒度特征，再在UV域稠密化捕捉细粒度细节；3) 即插即用的运动细化模块，对参数化变形之外的残差运动进行建模，实现主体特定动态个性化。

Result: FFAvatar能够高效生成高保真、可控的4D头部化身，在灵活性、驱动效率和跨表情/视角的身份一致性渲染方面均达到优越性能。

Conclusion: FFAvatar通过增量重建、注意力解耦和稀疏到密集学习等设计，有效解决了头部化身快速构建中的效率、质量和灵活性权衡问题。

Abstract: We present FFAvatar, a Transformer-based 3D Gaussian framework for fast construction of high-quality and animatable 4D head avatars from one or more reference portrait images. Unlike existing feed-forward approaches that require a fixed number of input views, FFAvatar supports incremental reconstruction, progressively refining the avatar representation as additional reference images become available. At the core of our method is an alternating attention mechanism that disentangles identity appearance from expression and viewpoint variations, enabling the reconstruction of a canonical 3D appearance that remains consistent across poses and facial expressions. To balance visual fidelity and computational efficiency, we introduce a sparse-to-dense learning paradigm. Coarse appearance features are first learned using sparse primitives anchored to the FLAME vertex level and are subsequently densified in the UV domain to capture fine-grained geometric and texture details. We further propose a plug-and-play motion refinement module that enables subject-specific dynamic personalization by modeling residual motion beyond parametric deformation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FFAvatar efficiently produces high-fidelity and controllable 4D head avatars, achieving superior flexibility, driving efficiency, and identity-consistent rendering across diverse expressions and viewpoints.

</details>


### [210] [LETT-NeXt: A Lightweight RECIST-Guided Model for 3D CT Lesion Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30108)
*Sebastian Aas,Elias Stenhede,Arian Ranjbar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 LETT-NeXt，一种轻量级 RECIST 引导的 3D 病变分割模型，在 CVPR 2026 胰腺癌 CT 分割竞赛中，通过将 RECIST 标记编码为提示通道，在验证集和测试集上分别取得了 79.4% 和 73.9% 的 Dice 系数，推理速度快且内存占用低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 RECIST 直径测量仅提供病灶的 2D 描述，无法全面反映三维病变范围。本文旨在利用 RECIST 标记（直径线和端点）作为先验知识，引导模型从 CT 体积中预测完整的 3D 病变掩膜，在保持轻量化的同时提升分割精度。

Method: 1) 提取 RECIST 中心区域裁剪；2) 将 RECIST 线和端点编码为两个提示通道，与 CT 输入拼接；3) 使用紧凑型 MedNeXt-v2 编码器-解码器预测病变掩膜；4) 进行提示感知的组件选择和自适应 AutoZoom 推理。

Result: 公开验证集：DSC=79.4±10.1，NSD=72.3±16.2；隐藏测试集：DSC=73.9，NSD=67.3，挑战评分 70.6%；CPU 推理时间 6.9±3.0 秒/例，峰值内存 3.6 GB。

Conclusion: LETT-NeXt 是一种高效、轻量级的 RECIST 引导 3D 病变分割方案，在精度和效率之间取得了良好平衡，代码已开源。

Abstract: RECIST diameter measurements are widely used for tumor response assessment, but they provide only a limited 2D description of lesion extent. We present LETT-NeXt, a lightweight RECIST-guided model that predicts 3D lesion masks from CT volumes and RECIST markers for the CVPR 2026 Foundation Models for Pan-cancer Segmentation in CT Images competition. LETT-NeXt extracts a RECIST-centered regional crop, encodes the RECIST line and endpoints as two prompt channels, and concatenates them with the CT input. A compact MedNeXt-v2 encoder--decoder predicts the lesion mask, followed by prompt-aware component selection and adaptive AutoZoom inference. On the public validation set, LETT-NeXt achieved a Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 79.4 $\pm$ 10.1 and a Normalized Surface Dice (NSD) of 72.3 $\pm$ 16.2. On the hidden test set, it achieved a DSC of 73.9 and an NSD of 67.3, corresponding to a challenge score of 70.6\%. On the public validation mirror, LETT-NeXt completed CPU inference in 6.9 $\pm$ 3.0 s per case with a peak memory use of 3.6 GB. Code is available at github.com/Ahus-AIM/lett-next.

</details>


### [211] [Residual-Guided Expert Specialization for Incomplete Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30355)
*Seunghun Baek,Jihwan Park,Jaeyoon Sim,Minjae Jeong,Hoseok Lee,Won Hwa Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MARS是一个基于混合专家模型的框架，通过缺失感知的残差信号引导专家专业化，有效应对多模态推理中的模态缺失问题，在多个任务上超越基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界中的预测系统常面临推理时模态缺失的问题，而现有方法学习到的缺失模态表征与完整模态表征之间存在不可避免的偏差，现有方法未能显式利用这种偏差来提升模型性能。

Method: 提出MARS框架，包含：(1) 残差路由：通过对比不完整输入与完整输入的任务表征，得到表征差距的残差信号，引导样本分配给对应偏差模式的专家；(2) 特征路由：仅用不完整输入模仿残差路由行为，实现无完整模态的推理部署；(3) 差异感知噪声正则化：当特征路由偏离残差路由时自适应扰动残差路由决策，增强专家鲁棒性。

Result: 在多模态分类（CASIA-SURF、CREMA-D、UPMC Food-101）和分割（MCubeS）任务上的缺失场景实验中，MARS一致超越基线方法，同时保持高效性并支持多种骨干网络和任务。

Conclusion: MARS通过显式利用缺失引起的表征偏差，以混合专家方式引导专家专业化，有效解决了不完整多模态学习问题，且具有良好的可扩展性和效率。

Abstract: As real-world prediction systems often face missing modalities at inference, incomplete multimodal learning (IML) remains a practical challenge. While prior methods aim to learn representations robust to missing inputs, representations from incomplete modalities inevitably deviate from their full-modality counterparts due to missing evidence. To explicitly leverage these deviations, we propose MARS (Missingness-Aware Residual-guided Specialization), a mixture-of-experts framework that guides expert specialization based on how representations are reshaped by missingness. By contrasting task representations derived from incomplete inputs with their complete counterparts during training, we derive a privileged residual signal that captures this representational gap. The residual signal guides a residual router to assign samples to experts specialized for the corresponding deviation patterns. In parallel, a feature router learns to imitate this routing behavior using only incomplete inputs, enabling deployment without access to full modalities. To mitigate this train-test router gap, we develop a discrepancy-aware noise regularization that adaptively perturbs the residual router's decisions when the feature router deviates, enhancing expert robustness under imperfect imitation. Experiments on multimodal classification (CASIA-SURF, CREMA-D, UPMC Food-101) and segmentation (MCubeS) under missing scenarios show that MARS consistently surpasses baselines while remaining efficient and extensible to diverse backbones and tasks.

</details>


### [212] [SciIR: A Large-scale Training Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Image Reasoning Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30124)
*Zhiyuan Ma,Zhengfeng Shi,Yuning An,Peize Li,Jiabao Wei,Ruijie Li,Junhao Xiao,Jianjun Li,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Scientific Image Reasoning (SciIR) 框架，包含大规模数据集 SciIR-82k（8万+科学图像-文本对）和评估基准 SciIR-Bench，基于皮尔斯符号学三元组（图标/索引/符号）将科学推理分为实体结构、科学过程、科学定律三个维度，并通过微调 Qwen-Image-SciIR 模型将基准得分从35%提升至43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生图模型在生成照片级视觉内容方面表现出色，但在科学图像所需的严格语义对齐和逻辑推理方面存在严重不足，且缺乏专门针对科学图像生成的大规模训练数据和系统化评估基准。

Method: 1）基于皮尔斯符号学三元组将科学推理形式化为三个核心维度：实体结构（图标）、科学过程（索引）、科学定律（符号）；2）构建 SciIR-82k 数据集，包含超8万对来自前沿出版物的高质量科学图像-文本对，按符号学维度分层组织并引入科学推理思维链（Sci-RCoT）；3）提出 SciIR-Bench 评估基准，采用原子检查表将面向结果的科学准确性转化为面向过程、可验证的细粒度问题。

Result: 实验揭示当前模型在科学推理能力上存在显著缺陷；通过微调得到的 Qwen-Image-SciIR 模型在 SciIR-Bench 上实现大幅提升，最终得分从35%提高到43%。

Conclusion: 该工作为未来科学图像生成领域的进步奠定了坚实基础，验证了符号学驱动的数据构建和细粒度评估方法在提升模型科学推理能力方面的有效性。

Abstract: While Text-to-Image (T2I) models have shown remarkable success in generating photorealistic visual content, they still struggle with the rigorous semantic alignment and logical reasoning required for scientific imagery. Inspired by Peirce's Semiotic Triad, we introduce Scientific Image Reasoning (SciIR), a comprehensive resource for training and evaluation of scientific image generation. We formalize scientific reasoning into three core dimensions: Entity Structure (Icon), Scientific Process (Index), and Scientific Law (Symbol). Specifically, to overcome the scarcity of training data in scientific image generation, we elaborately create SciIR-82k, a large-scale dataset containing over 80,000 high-quality scientific image-text pairs from cutting-edge publications. The dataset is hierarchically organized according to the semiotic dimensions and incorporates a Scientific Reasoning Chain-of-Thought (Sci-RCoT) to explicitly model underlying visual logic. For evaluation, we propose SciIR-Bench, which aligns with these three semiotic levels and employs an Atomic Checklist to convert the outcome-oriented scientific accuracy into process-oriented, verifiable, fine-grained questions. Our extensive experiments reveal significant deficiencies in current models' scientific reasoning capabilities. Furthermore, by fine-tuning on the SciIR-82k dataset, we developed the Qwen-Image-SciIR model, which achieves a substantial improvement on the SciIR-Bench, increasing the final score from 35\% to 43\%, laying a solid foundation for future advances in scientific image generation.

</details>


### [213] [Set-Inclusive Uncertainty Modeling for Robust Brain Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30374)
*Seunghun Baek,Jihwan Park,Jaeyoon Sim,Hoseok Lee,Seungjoo Lee,Won Hwa Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于高斯分布的概率表示框架（SIUM），用于多模态MRI脑肿瘤分割中应对缺失模态带来的不确定性。通过均值-方差建模、模态对齐正则化和集合包含约束，在BraTS 2018/2020上取得了优于基线方法的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态MRI对脑肿瘤分割至关重要，但实际推理中常缺失部分模态。现有确定性方法忽视缺失模态带来的内在不确定性，导致模型在信息不完整时产生看似合理但不可靠的表示。

Method: 1) 将潜在表示建模为高斯分布（均值编码任务信息，方差编码缺失证据的不确定性）；2) 通过将部分配置的均值对齐到完整模态均值，并根据对齐后的均值差异缩放方差来反映信息缺失程度；3) 提出集合包含策略，利用模态子集的层次结构并施加排序约束以维持一致的不确定性关系。

Result: 在BraTS 2018和BraTS 2020数据集上，该方法在各种缺失模态场景下均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 所提概率表示框架有效建模了缺失模态带来的不确定性，提高了多模态MRI在部分模态缺失情况下的分割鲁棒性和可靠性。

Abstract: Multimodal MRI is essential for accurate brain tumor segmentation. However, acquiring all modalities at inference is often challenging in practice, which causes intrinsic uncertainty due to unavoidable information loss. Without modeling this uncertainty, existing methods encode incomplete evidence into deterministic representations that appear plausible but lack reliability. In this regime, we propose a probabilistic representation framework that models representations as Gaussian distributions, where their mean captures task information and their variance measures uncertainty from missing evidence. To make variance reflect information deficiency, we regularize the mean from each partial configuration toward its full-modality counterpart, while scaling the variance with the discrepancy between their aligned means. We further introduce a set-inclusive strategy that exploits the hierarchical structure of modality subsets and enforces an ordering constraint to maintain their consistent uncertainty relationships. Extensive experiments on BraTS 2018 and 2020 demonstrate that our approach offers superior performance over baselines across diverse missing-modality scenarios. Code and model checkpoint are available at https://github.com/atlas-sky/SIUM.

</details>


### [214] [Beyond Point Estimates for Glaucoma Visual Field Forecasting with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30417)
*Marta Colmenar Herrera,Pablo Márquez Neila,Şerife Seda Kucur Ergünay,Martin S. Zinkernagel,Raphael Sznitman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于条件去噪扩散模型的视野预测方法，将视野预测建模为概率问题，生成未来视野的分布而非单一估计，在两个独立队列上实现了校准良好的概率预测和最优的点估计精度，推动青光眼评估向不确定性感知方向转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青光眼视野预测存在固有不确定性（疾病进展异质性、测量变异性），现有方法仅输出确定性点估计，无法表征预测不确定性，缺乏概率化建模手段。

Method: 将视野预测形式化为概率预测问题，使用条件去噪扩散模型，从纵向不规则随访观测中生成未来视野的分布。

Result: 在两个独立视野数据集上，扩散模型生成的概率分布校准良好；还原为点估计时达到最先进精度，优于临床基线和现有学习方法。

Conclusion: 分布建模在视野预测中具有显著优势，应推动青光眼评估从点估计预测转向不确定性感知的临床可解释风险评估。

Abstract: Forecasting visual fields (VFs) is critical for personalized monitoring and treatment planning in glaucoma. This is inherently uncertain due to heterogeneous disease progression and measurement variability, yet most existing methods produce single deterministic predictions that fail to represent this uncertainty. We formulate VF forecasting as a probabilistic prediction problem and the use of conditioned denoising diffusion models to generate distributions of plausible future VFs from longitudinal observations with irregular follow-up intervals. Experiments on two independent VF cohorts show that diffusion-based predictions produce well-calibrated distributions for clinically relevant VF measures. When reduced to a standard point-estimate, the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy compared to clinical baselines and prior learning-based methods. Our results highlight the advantages of distributional modeling for VF forecasting and support a shift from point-estimate prediction toward uncertainty-aware, clinically interpretable risk assessment in glaucoma.

</details>


### [215] [T2LDM++: A Self-Conditioned Representation Guided Diffusion Model for Realistic Text-to-LiDAR Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30147)
*Wentao Qu,Qi Zhang,Chenxu Wang,Guofeng Mei,Yongfei Liu,Xiaoshui Huang,Gim Hee Lee,Liang Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出T2LDM++，一种文本到LiDAR扩散模型，通过自条件表示引导（SCRG）缓解物体过平滑问题，构建了两个高质量文本-LiDAR基准数据集（>10万样本），并支持多种条件生成任务，实现了具有丰富几何细节的真实LiDAR场景生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本-LiDAR对的稀缺导致生成场景过平滑且可控性有限，现有方法缺乏有效的先验建模和高质量数据基准。

Method: 提出T2LDM++模型，核心是Self-Conditioned Representation Guidance (SCRG)，包含引导网络（GN）提供基于重建的软监督给去噪网络（DN），使DN学习几何感知表示；设计了方向位置先验缓解街道畸变；构建了两个高质量文本-LiDAR基准数据集；支持多种条件控制（语义、边界框、BEV、相机到LiDAR等）。

Result: 在无条件和有条件设置下均能生成具有丰富几何细节的真实LiDAR场景，有效缓解了物体过平滑问题，且SCRG在推理时可解耦，不增加计算开销。

Conclusion: 通过有效的先验建模和高质量文本-LiDAR基准数据集，T2LDM++在文本到LiDAR生成任务上取得了显著改进，支持多种条件生成，具有良好的实用性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Recent progress in Text-to-Image generation benefits from large-scale Text-Image pairs. However, the scarcity of Text-LiDAR pairs often causes over-smoothed scenes and limited controllability. In this paper, we rethink the limitations of Text-LiDAR generation task, focusing on alleviating insufficient training priors and constructing controllable Text-LiDAR data. We propose a \textbf{T}ext-\textbf{to}-\textbf{L}iDAR \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{M}odel for LiDAR scene generation, T2LDM++, with a Self-Conditioned Representation Guidance (SCRG). Specifically, to alleviate object over-smoothing, SCRG employs a Guidance Network (GN) to provide reconstruction-based soft supervision to the Denoising Network (DN). This enables DN to learn geometry-aware representations through reconstruction guidance, leading to more accurate denoising in DDPMs. Meanwhile, through analysis and design, SCRG exhibits more effective and lightweight, while decoupled in inference, avoiding computational overhead. Furthermore, we construct two high-quality Text-LiDAR benchmarks ($>$100K samples) using a generalized strategy of geometric annotations, along with a controllability metric. Moreover, a directional position prior is designed to mitigate street distortion, further improving scene fidelity. Additionally, T2LDM++ supports multiple conditions, including (Semantic, Box, BEV, Camera)-to-LiDAR, Sparse-to-Dense, and Dense-to-Sparse generation, by learning a control encoder via frozen DN. With effective prior modeling and high-quality Text-LiDAR benchmarks, T2LDM++ can generate realistic LiDAR scenes with rich geometric details in unconditional and conditional settings.

</details>


### [216] [A Dual-domain Refinement Network with FBP-based Jacobian Learning for Sparse-view Dual-Energy CT Material Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30159)
*Qian Liu,Xiaohong Fan,Ke Chen,Chong Chen,Shuaikang Wang,Jianping Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏视角下的双能CT多材料分解问题，提出了一种迭代双域优化网络（DECT-DRNet），通过FBP驱动的雅可比近似模块和可学习的稀疏双域正则化项，在非线性前向模型框架下实现了更精确的材料分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角采集可降低辐射剂量，但使得原本非线性和病态的双能CT材料分解问题更加困难。现有深度展开方法未显式引入非线性前向模型的雅可比算子，且其稀疏先验仍基于常规卷积，难以建模全局结构信息。

Method: 将问题建模为稀疏正则化非线性最小二乘问题，提出DECT-DRNet。每次迭代包含两个模块：(1) FBP驱动的雅可比近似模块——用非线性算子刻画前向过程，通过FBP算法结合U-Net构建可学习的伴随雅可比算子近似；(2) 可学习稀疏双域正则化项——引入傅里叶卷积残差块，在图像域提取几何特征同时在频域抑制噪声，捕获全局与局部特征。

Result: DECT-DRNet在稀疏视角条件下能够实现更精确的材料分解，验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模非线性前向模型并引入双域正则化，DECT-DRNet有效提升了稀疏视角下双能CT材料分解的精度，克服了现有方法在全局噪声与伪影抑制上的不足。

Abstract: Dual-energy CT (DECT) exploits attenuation differences across different X-ray spectra to provide richer material information and has been widely used in medical imaging. While sparse-view acquisition can lower radiation exposure, it makes DECT material decomposition even more challenging, as the problem is nonlinear and ill-posed. Existing deep unrolling approaches generally do not explicitly incorporate the Jacobian operator induced by the nonlinear forward model, and their sparsity priors are still mainly built on conventional convolutions, which are insufficient for modeling global structural information. This study addresses the challenge of DECT multi-material decomposition in sparse-view settings by representing it as a sparse-regularized nonlinear least-squares problem. To solve it, we propose an iterative dual-domain refinement network (DECT-DRNet). In each iteration, the filtered back-projection (FBP)-based Jacobian approximation module is used first to generate an intermediate material decomposition result. Here, we characterize the forward process of material decomposition using a nonlinear operator, and then construct a theoretically grounded learnable approximation of the adjoint Jacobian operator by integrating the FBP algorithm with a U-Net into the backward process. In addition, to address the limitation of existing deep learning-based decomposition methods in globally suppressing noise and artifacts, we introduce a learnable sparse dual domain regularization term that incorporates Fourier convolutional residual blocks. This refinement block combines geometric feature extraction in the image domain with noise suppression in the frequency domain, allowing the model to capture both global and local features while maintaining structural details. DECT-DRNet demonstrates its ability to achieve more accurate material decomposition under sparse-view conditions.

</details>


### [217] [Latent Noise Mask for Reducing Visual Redundancy in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30168)
*Kai Jiang,Ruishu Zhu,Siqi Huang,Hongyuan Zhang,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LatEnt Noise maSk (Lens)，一种基于问题条件的视觉证据净化框架，通过轻量级LET标记评估视觉令牌与问题的相关性，并引入自适应潜在噪声抑制低相关令牌，从而在不改变模型主干或序列长度的情况下提升多模态大语言模型的细粒度视觉推理能力，在VQA和定位任务上分别提升2.4-6.4和4.1-6.4个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在细粒度视觉推理中常因密集冗余的图像令牌稀释了问题相关的视觉线索而失败，现有方法扩展推理轨迹但忽视了冗余视觉令牌的负面影响。

Method: 提出Lens框架，包含一个轻量级Lens Evidence Token (LET)用于评分视觉令牌与当前问题的相关性，并根据评分向低相关令牌注入自适应潜在噪声，软性抑制干扰项，无需改变模型主干或令牌序列。

Result: 仅需一个临时可学习控制令牌和轻量级噪声生成器，在多数VQA数据集上提升2.4-6.4个点，在定位任务上提升4.1-6.4个点。

Conclusion: 多模态推理从更干净的问题相关视觉证据中获益比简单扩展推理轨迹更直接有效。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often fail in fine-grained visual reasoning, as question-relevant visual cues are diluted by dense and redundant image tokens. Recent multimodal reasoning methods usually extend chain-of-thought from language models into visual or latent spaces, seeking to add intermediate reasoning states while overlooking the negative impact of redundant visual tokens. We propose LatEnt Noise maSk (Lens), a question-conditioned visual evidence purification framework that empowers MLLMs to reason with cleaner visual cues in latent space. Lens introduces a lightweight Lens Evidence Token (LET) to score which visual tokens support the current question and preserve them during decoding. Guided by the LET scores, it injects adaptive latent noise into low-relevance tokens, softly suppressing distractors without changing the model backbone or token sequence. With only one temporary learnable control token and a lightweight noise generator, Lens adds minimal overhead while improving the base MLLM by 2.4-6.4 points on most VQA datasets and by 4.1-6.4 points on grounding tasks. These results show that multimodal reasoning can benefit more directly from cleaner question-relevant visual evidence than from simply extending the reasoning trace.

</details>


### [218] [On the Faithfulness of Post-Hoc Concept Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30498)
*Laines Schmalwasser,Jan Blunk,Niklas Penzel,Julia Niebling,Joachim Denzler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了后验概念瓶颈模型（post-hoc CBMs）中概念投影的两种失效模式：协变量偏移导致的概念不忠实，以及视觉语言模型代理标签的系统性噪声。作者提出了新的评估指标，将概念忠实度与预测精度解耦，实验证明这些指标能识别出标准准确率评估无法检测的不忠实行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后验CBM依赖目标任务准确率作为成功指标，但随机概念投影也能达到竞争性准确率，说明准确率无法衡量概念是否具有语义意义。作者旨在直接分析投影，识别并形式化概念不忠实的根本原因。

Method: 1) 理论上界定了辅助数据协变量偏移引入的误差；2) 形式化了视觉语言模型代理标签的系统性噪声问题；3) 提出了解耦概念忠实度与预测精度的新评估指标。

Result: 在真实和合成基准上，新指标成功识别了标准准确率评估未能检测的不忠实行为，验证了所提出的失效模式确实存在且可被量化。

Conclusion: 仅靠预测准确率不足以评估后验CBM的概念质量，需引入专门的概念忠实度指标；协变量偏移和标签噪声是概念不忠实的两大核心来源。

Abstract: Human decision-making interprets the world through high-level concepts, such as recognizing a bird by its belly color. To bridge the gap between opaque deep learning representations and human understanding, Post-Hoc Concept Bottleneck Models (post-hoc CBMs) project latent features onto interpretable concept spaces using auxiliary datasets or vision-language models. However, relying on target task accuracy as the primary measure of post-hoc CBM success obscures whether the learned concepts are semantically meaningful or merely predictive artifacts. For example, random concept projections can achieve competitive accuracy despite being semantically meaningless. In this work, we analyze the learned projections directly and identify two failure cases: First, for concept projections learned from auxiliary data, covariate shifts can lead to unfaithful concept representations for the target task. In particular, we provide an upper bound on the error introduced by this shift. Second, systematic label noise in surrogate concept labels generated by vision-language models leads to unfaithful projections. After formalizing these failure modes, we introduce novel metrics that decouple concept faithfulness from predictive accuracy. Our empirical results across real-world and synthetic benchmarks confirm that these metrics identify unfaithful behaviors that standard accuracy-based evaluation fails to detect.

</details>


### [219] [HiRes: A Hierarchical Cascaded Method for Resistor Value Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30179)
*Rama Y. AlHamidi,Aseel A. Mohamed,Mustafa A. Eltayeb,Osama Hasoneh,Mohammad Shaqfeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HiRes，一种层级级联流水线，结合目标检测（YOLOv8n）、语义分割（UNet+++EfficientNet-B2）和结构化几何解码，实现从全帧图像中端到端识别电阻值，在真实场景下达到85.8%的识别准确率，优于CVResist和SOTA多模态大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从非约束图像中准确识别电阻值因光照、方向、尺度和背景复杂度的变化而仍然具有挑战性，现有经典基线方法（如CVResist）无法泛化到受控条件之外的场景。

Method: 构建层级级联流水线：1) YOLOv8n进行电阻对象检测；2) UNet++搭配EfficientNet-B2骨干网络进行语义分割；3) 沿电阻轴进行投影实现结构化几何解码。同时引入几何滤波、间隙保留色带分离以及E24电阻系列校验以增强鲁棒性。

Result: 检测mAP50达0.9906，分割mIoU达0.8444，端到端识别准确率85.8%（95% CI: 78.0-91.9%），全面超越CVResist基线及SOTA多模态大模型，且成本更低、效率更高、可解释性更强。

Conclusion: 将学到的视觉表征与结构化推理相结合，是实现鲁棒电阻识别的有效途径，为工业场景下的低成本、高效且可解释的电阻自动识别提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Accurate identification of resistor values from unconstrained images remains a challenging computer vision task due to variations in lighting, orientation, scale, and background complexity. This paper presents HiRes, a hierarchical cascaded pipeline for end-to-end resistor value identification directly from full-frame images. The approach combines object detection (YOLOv8n), semantic segmentation (UNet++ with EfficientNet-B2), and structured geometric decoding via projection along the resistor axis. To improve robustness, we incorporate geometric filtering, gap-preserving band separation, and validation against the E24 resistor series. Experiments across diverse real-world images show that HiRes achieves a detection mAP50 of 0.9906, a segmentation mIoU of 0.8444, and an end-to-end identification accuracy of 85.8% (95% CI: 78.0-91.9%), outperforming the publicly available classical baseline, CVResist, which fails to generalize beyond controlled conditions. In addition, our architecture outperforms state-of-the-art MLLMs on our challenging test set, offering a lower cost, high efficiency, and an interpretable alternative method. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of integrating learned visual representations with structured reasoning for robust resistor interpretation. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/HiRes491/HiRes.

</details>


### [220] [DrivenMorph: Bridging Attention Mechanism and Variational Image Registration via Difference Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30183)
*Mingke Li,Jianping Zhang,Jinqiu Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DrivenMorph通过将Demons算法的物理启发式偏置与注意力机制结合，利用局部特征差异显式驱动配准过程，在3D脑MRI数据上取得了优于现有方法的性能，同时提升了可解释性和模块化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习医学图像配准方法缺乏物理可解释性和细粒度形变控制。

Method: 提出DrivenMorph框架，引入差异建模作为物理启发的归纳偏置，通过神经Demons层模拟力-位移交互生成平滑且解剖一致的形变场，将差异建模与形变解耦以提升模块化。

Result: 在多个3D脑MRI数据集上，性能优于现有基于学习和基于优化的最先进方法；可视化与统计分析验证了驱动力与实际形变模式的一致性。

Conclusion: 该方法成功融合了传统配准原理与深度网络，提供了可解释且高效的医学图像配准方案。

Abstract: Medical image registration benefits significantly from deep learning, yet existing approaches often lack physical explainability and fine-grained deformation control. Motivated by Demons algorithms, we propose a novel DrivenMorph framework that bridges attention mechanisms with variational image registration by incorporating difference modeling as a physically inspired inductive bias. The resulting driving force, computed from local differences in the latent feature space, provides explicit semantic guidance throughout the registration process. It directly drives the registration process through a neural Demons layer that simulates force-displacement interactions to generate smooth and anatomically consistent deformation. Unlike previous methods, our approach not only integrates traditional registration principles with popular deep networks, providing an explainable and efficient solution for learning-based medical image registration, but also separates difference modeling from deformation, improving modularity and explainability. Extensive experiments on multiple 3D brain MRI datasets demonstrate superior performance over state of-the-art learning-based and optimization-based methods. Furthermore, visualizations and statistical analyses confirm that the learned driving force aligns closely with actual deformation patterns, supporting its explanatory value.

</details>


### [221] [Beyond 2D Matching: A Unified Single-Stage Framework for Geometry-Aware Cross-View Object Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30576)
*Liyao Wang,Ruipu Wu,Haojun Xu,Lei Shi,Linjiang Huang,Si Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出大规模高保真建筑数据集CVOGL（超22万对地面-卫星和无人机-卫星图像），以及基于3D基础模型π³的单阶段几何感知定位框架GAGeo，通过多模态提示（点、框、掩码）、相机姿态预测和对比学习，实现跨视角目标地理定位，显著超越现有方法并在未见场景和新型跨视图设置中展现优异泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨视角目标地理定位方法过度依赖2D外观匹配，且受限于缺乏几何元数据、多样化提示和标准视场图像的数据集，导致方法在复杂场景下泛化能力不足。

Method: 1) 构建大规模高保真建筑数据集CVOGL，提供多模态提示（点、框、掩码）和相机姿态；2) 提出单阶段GAGeo框架，基于置换等变3D基础模型π³，融合视觉特征、提示和可学习任务令牌，联合预测边界框、分割掩码和相机姿态；3) 引入以卫星视图为通用锚点的对比损失，隐式对齐地面和无人机表征，实现零样本跨视图定位。

Result: 在未见场景和新型跨视图设置（如零样本地面到无人机定位）中显著优于现有最先进方法，展现出优异的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过大规模多模态数据集与几何感知单阶段框架相结合，有效解决了跨视图目标地理定位中的数据稀缺和2D匹配局限问题，为实际应用提供了更具泛化性的解决方案。

Abstract: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to locate a target object from a query view (e.g., ground or drone) within a geo-tagged reference image (e.g., satellite). Existing approaches heavily rely on 2D appearance matching and are constrained by limited datasets lacking geometric metadata, diverse prompts, and standard field-of-view imagery. To address these intertwined challenges, we first introduce \dataset, a large-scale, high-fidelity building dataset comprising over 220,000 ground-satellite and drone-satellite pairs. It provides multi-modal prompts (points, boxes, masks) and camera poses to enable flexible target referring and explicit spatial modeling. Furthermore, we propose a novel single-stage Geometry-Aware Geo-localization framework (GAGeo), built upon the permutation-equivariant 3D foundation model $π^3$. By seamlessly integrating visual features, referring prompts, and learnable task tokens, our model adapts the inherited 3D prior to jointly predict bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and camera poses in a single forward pass. Additionally, we introduce a contrastive loss that utilizes the satellite view as a universal anchor, implicitly aligning ground and drone representations to enable zero-shot ground-to-drone localization without requiring triplet training data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, exhibiting exceptional generalization ability in unseen scenes and novel cross-view setups.

</details>


### [222] [From Accuracy to Visual Dependence: Auditing and Filtering Modality Collapse in Traffic VideoQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30220)
*Sena Korkut,María Alejandra Bravo Sarmiento,Sanghwan Kim,Zeynep Akata*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在交通事故VideoQA中，高基准准确率并不保证模型真正使用了视觉证据；许多VLM无需视频输入也能表现优异。本文提出Blind Gap、Visual Gain和Shortcut Score三个诊断指标来量化视觉依赖，并实现无训练的捷径问题过滤，从而提升视觉基础能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VideoQA基准的准确率虚高，模型可能依赖文本捷径而非真实视觉证据，尤其在安全关键的应用（如交通事故分析）中这一问题需要被揭示和解决。

Method: 通过对四个公开基准的审计，比较有/无视频输入下的VLM性能；提出数据集级指标Blind Gap（纯文本高于随机水平的表现）和Visual Gain（添加视频带来的边际收益）；提出实例级Shortcut Score，结合文本置信度与视觉必要性信号，实现无训练、连续化的捷径问题过滤。

Result: 在MM-AU基准上，移除视频反而持续提升准确率，增加更多帧会进一步降低性能。过滤后的子集减少了捷径偏差，改善了视觉基础能力。不同基准间的视觉基础质量存在巨大差异。

Conclusion: 视觉基础的评估（而非仅仅高准确率）在安全关键的VideoQA中至关重要；本文提出的诊断和过滤方法能有效识别和缓解文本捷径问题。

Abstract: High benchmark accuracy does not guarantee genuine use of visual evidence. We study this problem in traffic accident Video Question Answering (VideoQA), where correct answers should depend on scene-specific visual evidence but may instead be inferred from textual shortcuts. Through an audit of four public benchmarks, we find that several recent open-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform competitively, and sometimes better, without video input. On the MM-AU benchmark, removing video consistently improves accuracy, and adding more frames further degrades performance. To quantify visual dependence, we introduce two dataset-level diagnostics: Blind Gap, measuring above-chance text-only performance, and Visual Gain, measuring the marginal benefit of adding video. We further propose an instance-level Shortcut Score that combines text-only confidence with visual necessity signals, enabling continuous, training-free filtering of shortcut-prone questions. The resulting subsets reduce shortcut bias and improve visual grounding. Our findings reveal large differences in grounding quality across benchmarks and show that visually grounded evaluation, not just high accuracy, is essential in safety-critical VideoQA.

</details>


### [223] [Semantic-Driven Scale and Spatial Selection for Efficient Cross-Modal Alignment in Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30244)
*Kun Li,Shengxi Gui,Francesco Nex,Michael Ying Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出S4ECA框架，通过参数高效微调（仅更新2.4%骨干参数）实现遥感图像指代分割，在双编码器适配器中利用文本适配器蒸馏语义代理和视觉适配器的多尺度密集提取与语言引导的尺度-空间选择机制，实现高效跨模态对齐，在RRSIS-D和RefSegRS数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RRSIS模型依赖全量微调，计算成本高且会损害预训练模型的泛化能力；而现有参数高效微调方法主要关注单模态优化，无法捕捉跨模态依赖关系，也难以弥合自然场景与航拍图像之间的领域差距。

Method: 提出S4ECA框架，核心为双编码器适配器架构：(1) 文本适配器通过可学习查询从词级嵌入中蒸馏高层语义语言代理，实现早期接地；(2) 视觉适配器通过多尺度密集提取器细化层次化特征，再经语言引导的尺度与空间选择机制动态强调相关视觉上下文，实现精确跨模态对齐。仅更新2.4%骨干参数。

Result: 在RRSIS-D和RefSegRS数据集上达到SOTA性能，仅更新2.4%骨干参数即实现高效精确的遥感图像指代分割。

Conclusion: S4ECA通过参数高效的方式有效解决了遥感图像指代分割中的跨模态对齐和领域差距问题，在极低参数更新比例下实现了优异的性能，为遥感领域的参数高效微调提供了新范式。

Abstract: Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) seeks to localize and segment the target object or region specified by a natural language expression in a remote sensing image. While existing RRSIS models have benefited from large-scale foundation models, they predominantly rely on full fine-tuning. These approaches are computationally intensive and may weaken the generalization ability of pre-trained models, as extensive fine-tuning on significantly smaller downstream datasets can distort the well-structured feature representations learned during large-scale pre-training. Although Parameter-Efficient Tuning (PET) offers a potential alternative, existing PET frameworks primarily focus on single-modal optimization, failing to capture the complex cross-modal dependencies required for multimodal reasoning, while simultaneously struggling to bridge the substantial domain gap between natural scenes and aerial imagery. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework, Semantic-driven Scale and Spatial Selection for Efficient Cross-modal Alignment (S4ECA), which enables effective and efficient cross-modal interaction through parameter-efficient adaptation. Specifically, we design a dual-encoder adapter architecture. The textual adapter employs learnable queries to distill highly semantic language proxies from word-level embeddings, facilitating early grounding. Simultaneously, the visual adapter refines hierarchical feature representations through a multi-scale dense extractor, followed by a language-guided scale and spatial selection mechanism that dynamically emphasizes relevant visual contexts, ensuring precise cross-modal alignment. By updating only 2.4% of the backbone parameters, our proposed model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the RRSIS-D and RefSegRS datasets, demonstrating superior efficiency and precision in complex aerial scenarios.

</details>


### [224] [Your Data Manifold is Secretly a Reward Model: Shell-LCC for Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30248)
*Shihao Zhang,Yuguang Yan,Junzhe Zhang,Wei Zhao,Bohan Wang,Hanwang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Shell-LCC方法，通过建模高质量SFT数据流形结构，无需额外奖励信号即可提升文本到视频扩散模型的生成质量，有效减少运动模糊和过度平滑伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2V扩散模型依赖辅助奖励信号（如奖励模型或DPO）来对齐人类审美，但这些方法计算开销大、需要昂贵的人工标注，且对细粒度局部细节提升有限。

Method: 基于局部坐标编码（LCC）建模高质量SFT数据流形骨架，针对LCC存在的均值回归问题（拉向几何均值丢失高频细节），扩展为Shell-LCC，将流形表面建模为各向同性壳层以匹配真实高密度区域。

Result: 方法提升了生成视频的真实感和高频细节，减少了过度平滑伪影和运动模糊。

Conclusion: 高质量数据流形本身可充当隐式奖励模型，通过Shell-LCC可获取密集、可微且近乎零成本的奖励信号，显著提升视频质量。

Abstract: Recent text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models rely heavily on auxiliary reward signals (e.g., via reward models or DPO) to align generated content with human aesthetics and improve realism. These signals, however, incur substantial computational overhead, require costly human annotations, and often yield limited improvement in fine-grained local details. In this paper, we argue that your data manifold is secretly a reward model. By explicitly modeling the manifold structure of high-quality Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) data and encouraging video latents to lie on this manifold, we derive dense, differentiable, and nearly cost-free reward signals that significantly improve video quality, particularly in mitigating low-level distortions. Our modeling builds upon Local Coordinate Coding (LCC), which captures the `skeleton' of the manifold. However, directly applying LCC suffers from mean regression, pulling latents toward the geometric mean and losing high-frequency details. We therefore extend it to Shell Local Coordinate Coding (Shell-LCC), which models the manifold `surface' as an isotropic shell to align with the true high-density region. Experiments demonstrate that our approach improves realism, enhances high-frequency details, reduces over-smoothing artifacts, and alleviates motion blur.

</details>


### [225] [Intermediate Text Representation Guided Text-to-Image Generation for Enhancing One-and-Only Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30262)
*Soyoun Won,Aryan Yazdan Parast,Basim Azam,Jean Honorio,Naveed Akhtar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现文本到图像扩散模型对“唯一对象”（如天体、地标、艺术品）存在强烈概念关联偏差，导致难以根据文本提示忠实生成。通过信息论分析发现最终文本嵌入丢失了中间层的概念信息，提出无需训练的中间文本表示引导扩散方法，在去噪早期注入中间隐藏状态以恢复被抑制的概念。引入OAO-AttackBench基准测试，在四个基准上实现高达19.1%的VQAScore提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型在生成“唯一对象”（如地球、蒙娜丽莎等具有单一规范形式的实体）时，存在强烈的概念关联偏差，导致模型倾向于默认学习到的视觉先验而忽视文本提示中的修改指令，传统提示工程难以克服这种根深蒂固的视觉身份。

Method: 通过信息论分析发现文本编码器最终层嵌入丢弃了中间层的概念级信息。提出IR-guided扩散方法，在去噪过程早期步骤将文本编码器的中间隐藏状态注入到条件信号中，无需额外训练、优化或外部模型即可恢复被抑制的概念信息。

Result: 在四个基准测试上，包括新提出的OAO-AttackBench，该方法在VQAScore上达到最高19.1%的改进，同时保持生成保真度和人类偏好不变。

Conclusion: 中间文本表示引导能有效缓解扩散模型对唯一对象的概念关联偏差，无需训练即可显著提升文本到图像生成的忠实度，为理解文本编码器中的信息流提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models often fail to faithfully render explicit textual descriptions, instead defaulting to strongly learned visual priors due to a phenomenon referred to as concept association bias. We show that such bias is particularly strong for one-and-only (OAO) objects, entities that exist in a single canonical form, such as celestial bodies, landmarks, and artworks. The deeply ingrained visual identity for these concepts often resists modification through prompting alone. Addressing this challenge, we first identify through an information-theoretic analysis that the final text embedding discards concept-level information present in the intermediate-layer text representations, reducing the mutual information available to the subsequent denoising process. We then propose Intermediate Text Representation (IR)-guided diffusion, which injects intermediate hidden states of the text encoder into the conditioning signal during early denoising steps, recovering suppressed concepts without any additional training, optimization, or external models. To systematically evaluate the challenging task of aligning generative outputs with unusual prompts for OAO objects, we introduce OAO-AttackBench, a benchmark comprising counterfactual prompts that directly conflict with the core visual identity of OAO objects. Experiments on four benchmarks, including OAO-AttackBench, show that our method achieves up to a 19.1 percentage-point improvement in VQAScore while preserving generation fidelity and human preference. Project page: https://soyoun-won.github.io/one-and-only-ir-guidance/.

</details>


### [226] [VisReflect: Latent Visual Reflection for Fine-Grained Perception in Long Visual Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30288)
*Xiaoqian Shen,Mohamed Elhoseiny*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VisReflect通过潜在空间视觉反射机制，在不依赖显式边界框预测和额外前向传播的情况下，有效缓解了LVLM在处理高分辨率图像和长视频时的视觉注意力沉没问题，在多个基准上取得一致提升，并将推理时间降低约44%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率图像和长视频场景下，视觉token数量激增导致严重的视觉注意力沉没现象（无关token吸收过多注意力），现有基于边界框/时间跨度预测的缩放方法依赖不可靠的离散token空间定位且计算开销大。

Method: 提出VisReflect框架：模型在潜在空间中生成连续的视觉反射特征，这些特征选择性突出与问题相关的视觉区域或帧，引导注意力聚焦于相关视觉token，整个过程仅需单次前向传播。

Result: 在多个高分辨率图像基准（BLINK、V*、HRBench-4K/8K）和视频理解基准（MVBench、VideoMME、MLVU）上，图像任务提升4.1%，视频任务提升1.8%；与缩放方法相比，推理时间降低约44%。

Conclusion: VisReflect通过潜在空间反射机制提供了一种更高效、更可靠的细粒度视觉感知方案，在不增加计算负担的前提下显著提升LVLM对长视觉上下文的理解能力。

Abstract: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable success on vision-language tasks, yet fine-grained perception over high-resolution images and long-context videos remains challenging. As the number of visual tokens increases, the visual attention sink phenomenon becomes increasingly severe, causing irrelevant tokens to absorb a disproportionate amount of attention mass. Recent approaches attempt to mitigate this issue by explicitly predicting bounding boxes or temporal spans and re-encoding the cropped visual regions. Such methods depend on unreliable numeric localization in the discrete token space and incur significant computational overhead due to additional forward passes. In this work, we propose **VisReflect**, a simple yet effective framework that improves fine-grained perception in long visual contexts through latent visual reflection. Instead of decoding intermediate predictions into discrete tokens, the model generates continuous visual reflection that represents question-relevant visual features in the latent space. These reflections selectively emphasize salient regions or frames, guiding attention towards relevant visual tokens within a single forward pass. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on challenging high-resolution image benchmarks, including BLINK, V*, and HRBench-4K/8K, as well as video understanding benchmarks such as MVBench, VideoMME, and MLVU. Our method consistently improves over strong baselines, achieving gains of 4.1% on image benchmarks and 1.8% on video benchmarks. Compared with zooming-based methods, our model achieves comparable performance while reducing inference time by roughly 44% on video understanding.

</details>


### [227] [The Surprising Effectiveness of Video Diffusion Models for Hand Motion Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30308)
*Yuxi Wang,Chengkai Jin,Yufei Liu,Wenqi Ouyang,Tianyi Wei,Zhiwei Zeng,Siyuan Huang,Zhiqi Shen,Xingang Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViDiHand利用预训练的视频扩散模型表征，通过手部覆盖渲染目标适配其特征，实现从全帧图像直接恢复公制尺度的4D双手姿态重建，在多项基准上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图像的方法依赖检测器，在严重遮挡下失效；基于视频的方法仅从稀疏的手部姿态标注中学习时序模块，信号不足，无法建模运动动态、遮挡推理和手物交互。视频生成模型在大规模训练中隐式获得了这些能力。

Method: 利用预训练视频扩散模型的表征，通过手部覆盖渲染目标（hand-overlay rendering objective）适配特征，同时保留世界先验；解码器从适配后的特征恢复公制尺度姿态；直接在全帧图像上运行，无需检测器、填充器或测试时优化。

Result: 在ARCTIC、HOT3D和HOI4D数据集上，ViDiHand显著优于先前方法。

Conclusion: 视频扩散模型可作为手部运动重建的强大新基础，并为可扩展的野外数据采集提供可行途径，助力具身AI发展。

Abstract: 4D hand motion reconstruction from egocentric video is bottlenecked by clear limitations of existing methods: image-based pipelines depend on a detector that fails under heavy occlusion, while video-based methods rely on temporal modules learned only from scarce hand-pose annotations, a narrow signal insufficient to model motion dynamics, occlusion reasoning, and hand-object interaction. These capabilities, however, are exactly what video generative models must implicitly acquire when trained to synthesize coherent video at internet scale. Motivated by this, we present ViDiHand, which leverages the representations of a pretrained video diffusion model to reconstruct 4D two-hand pose.
