Result: 所有六对比较均存在正负双向的子系统效应；所有随机效应95%预测区间均跨越零（即对特定子系统无法确定哪个方法更优）；5/6的配对比较中交互检验显著拒绝方法间差异的子系统间可交换性；LOSO选择在最多5/11的子系统上选出了实际表现更差的方法，最大遗憾值达24.8个百分点（RCAEval/Sock-Shop）。

Conclusion: RCA基准测试的池化排名在子系统层面不具有稳定的可推广性，单一排名推荐具有误导性。建议同时报告每个子系统的方法排名和稳定性检验结果。作者开源了一个320行的审计模块，可在给定匹配的RCA得分表后自动进行上述检验。

Abstract: Offline root-cause-analysis (RCA) benchmarks commonly rank methods by a single pooled top-1 accuracy across multiple subsystems, and engineers often read the pooled winner as a recommendation for their own subsystem. We audit that reading on three public RCA benchmark families -- OpenRCA, RCAEval, and PetShop -- covering 11 subsystems and 778 matched scoring units. To keep pairwise comparisons on identical cases, the main analysis retains four methods or comparators with complete coverage: BARO, a CD-1min adapter, max-$|Z|$, and per-service alert-count. All six pairwise comparisons show subsystem-level effects of both signs, every random-effects 95\% prediction interval crosses zero, and case-level interaction tests reject exchangeability in 5 of 6 pairs. Leave-one-system-out selection picks the lower-scoring method on up to 5 of 11 held-out subsystems, with regret reaching 24.8 pp on RCAEval / Sock-Shop. We release a 320-line audit module; given a matched RCA benchmark score table, it recomputes the same per-subsystem stability checks alongside pooled scores.

</details>


### [408] [Direct Causation in International Humanitarian Law and the Challenge of AI-Mediated Civilian Cyber Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29175)
*Alice Saito,Harold Godsoe,Phan Xuan Tan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文论证了当平民部署自主多智能体网络攻击系统时，ICRC《解释性指引》中"直接参与敌对行动"的"因果关系"标准（"一个因果步骤"和"组成部分"要求）失效，因为伤害由人类脱离后的系统自主决策产生，且"组成部分"要求预设了可独立分类的下游人类行为者。文章将AI中介行动按目标规范粒度分为五级，指出现有AI治理工具无法记录这一关键属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有国际人道法规则关于平民直接参与敌对行动的因果关系标准（特别是ICRC 2009年《解释性指引》中的三项累积测试）在面对AI中介的平民网络行动时出现结构性适用困难，尤其是直接因果关系要素无法有效规制自主多智能体系统造成的伤害。

Method: 本文采用国际人道法教义学分析，深入解析"一个因果步骤"标准和"组成部分"要求的逻辑预设，并结合自主多智能体网络攻击系统的技术特征（人类脱离后的系统自主决策），论证现有标准的适用困境。同时，本文识别目标规范粒度作为关键属性，对AI中介行动进行五级分类，并评估现有AI治理工具对该属性的覆盖情况。

Result: 研究发现：1) "一个因果步骤"标准因AI系统在人类脱离后自主生成决策而导致伤害，难以适用；2) "组成部分"要求因预设存在可独立分类的下游人类行为者而无法延伸至自主AI系统；3) 现有框架默认将此类部署视为间接参与，与捕捉"个人参与敌对行动"的立法目的相悖；4) 目标规范粒度是"组成部分"测试中"具体性"要求的隐含前提；5) 现有AI治理工具不记录或报告目标规范粒度。

Conclusion: 现有国际人道法关于直接参与敌对行动的因果关系测试无法有效规制AI中介网络行动，需要重新审视该标准的技术预设，并推动AI治理工具纳入目标规范粒度等关键技术属性，以弥合法律规范与技术实践之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: International humanitarian law protects civilians from direct attack unless and for such time as they take direct part in hostilities, with the ICRC's 2009 Interpretive Guidance operationalising this rule through a three-criterion cumulative test. This paper argues that AI-mediated civilian cyber operations challenge the direct causation element of this test in a structurally specific way: when a civilian deploys an autonomous multi-agent cyber system of the kind recently demonstrated in offensive AI research, the "one causal step" standard fails because harm is produced by system-generated decisions made after human disengagement, and the integral-part requirement does not extend because it presupposes downstream human contributors whose conduct can be independently classified. The framework therefore defaults to treating such deployments as indirect participation, in tension with its purpose of capturing civilians who personally take part in hostilities. Beyond the doctrinal analysis, this paper identifies goal-specification granularity as the property on which the integral-part test's concreteness component implicitly turns, classifies AI-mediated operations along a five-level spectrum, and argues that existing technical AI governance instruments do not log or report this property.

</details>


### [409] [Selective Memory Retention for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29178)
*Pranath Reddy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TraceRetain，一个轻量级框架，用于给冻结的LLM代理添加有界外部记忆。通过可解释特征（成功、年龄、访问频率、冗余度、特异性、相似性、下游效用）对记忆条目评分，容量满时驱逐最低分条目。在干净ALFWorld上，外部记忆优于无记忆，但不同保留策略间差异不显著。在受控噪声写入压力下，无界记忆和FIFO-K50性能下降，而TraceRetain-CEM基本不变，保持97/100任务成功率。有界保留在饱和干净基准上节省内存和步骤效率，仅在噪声流中区别于缓存启发式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在何种情况下保留策略对增强记忆的LLM代理至关重要，特别是当外部记忆有界且存在噪声干扰时。

Method: 提出TraceRetain框架，为冻结LLM代理维护有界外部记忆，使用多种可解释特征对条目评分，在容量满时驱逐最低分条目。在干净和噪声ALFWorld环境下进行实验对比。

Result: 在干净环境下，有界记忆策略间差异不显著；在75%合成干扰物噪声下，无界记忆和FIFO-K50的Precision@5大幅下降，TraceRetain-CEM基本不变（16.9%→16.6%），保持97/100任务成功率。无界记忆相似度最高（0.87）但精度最低。

Conclusion: 有界保留策略在干净饱和基准上以无任务成功代价换取内存和步骤效率，仅在包含噪声的数据流中才能与简单缓存启发式区分开来。记忆保留策略在噪声环境下至关重要。

Abstract: When does retention matter for memory-augmented LLM agents? We study this with TraceRetain, a lightweight framework for bounded external memory in frozen LLM agents that scores entries by interpretable features (success, age, access frequency, redundancy, specificity, similarity, downstream utility) and evicts the lowest-scoring ones at capacity. On clean ALFWorld with gpt-5-mini, external memory robustly improves over no memory across two seeds, but differences among bounded retention policies fall within Wilson 95% CIs: clean ALFWorld at T=100 to T=200 does not naturally exhibit the memory pollution retention is designed to address. Under a controlled noisy-write stress (75% synthetic distractors), unbounded memory and FIFO-K50 degrade on Precision@5 (20.2% to 12.4% and 15.8% to 3.8%) while TraceRetain-CEM is essentially unchanged (16.9% to 16.6%) and preserves 97/100 task success. The mechanism: unbounded memory has the highest mean similarity (0.87) but lowest precision, indicating failed distractors close to the query in embedding space. Held-out in-distribution evaluation shows memory-augmented policies solving 47 to 49 of 50 tasks vs. 39/50 for no memory. Bounded retention buys memory and step efficiency on saturated clean benchmarks at no task-success cost, and only differentiates from cache heuristics when streams contain noise.

</details>


### [410] [Measuring Graph-to-Graph Semantic Similarity in Knowledge Graphs: An Empirical Evaluation of Knowledge Graph Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29180)
*Seungryeol Baek,Wooseok Sim,Hogun Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对知识图谱（KG）中图级语义相似性评估不足的问题，提出通过修改文本来构建语义匹配数据集，并引入EmbPairSim和AvgEmbSim两种基于KG嵌入的评分函数。实验表明EmbPairSim在参数更少的情况下，MRR比Sentence-BERT高5.3个百分点，证明KGE表示能有效捕捉KG间的图级语义相似性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KG嵌入方法主要聚焦于实体、关系和三元组层面，缺乏对图级语义信息的建模；而传统图级方法仅依赖结构相似性，无法保证KG间的语义一致性。因此需要一种能评估KG间图级语义相似性的方法。

Method: 1) 构建语义匹配数据集：通过修改文本文档，从原文和修改后的文档中分别提取KG，并将已知的文档级对应关系迁移到KG对上。2) 提出两种基于KG嵌入的评分函数：EmbPairSim（最大成对实体相似度）和AvgEmbSim（频率加权质心）。3) 在WikiText-2和CC-News数据集上对比基于文本、基于结构和基于KG嵌入的方法。

Result: EmbPairSim在MRR指标上比Sentence-BERT高出最多5.3个百分点，且使用的参数量大幅减少。

Conclusion: KGE表示可以作为紧凑且有效的信号用于衡量KG间的图级语义相似性，为KG语义匹配提供了新思路。

Abstract: A Knowledge Graph (KG) represents facts as structured triples and is widely used to organize relational knowledge across diverse domains. Just as textual information ranges from words and sentences to complete documents, KG information can be interpreted at multiple levels, from entities, relations, and triples to subgraphs and entire KGs. However, existing KG embedding methods mainly focus on entities, relations, and triples, leaving graph-level semantics largely unaddressed. Conventional graph-level methods, which typically compare graphs based on structural patterns, are also insufficient because structural similarity alone cannot guarantee semantic similarity between KGs. To evaluate how well different methods capture such graph-level semantic information, we study graph-to-graph semantic similarity, which determines whether a pair of KGs represents semantically corresponding underlying information. To obtain reliable ground-truth correspondences, we construct a semantic matching dataset by modifying text documents, extracting KGs from both original and modified documents, and transferring their known correspondences to KG pairs. We compare text-based, structure-based, and KG embedding-based approaches on each dataset. For the KG embedding-based approach, we introduce two scoring functions: \textit{EmbPairSim}, which uses maximal pairwise entity similarity, and \textit{AvgEmbSim}, which uses a frequency-weighted centroid. Experiments on WikiText-2 and CC-News show that \textit{EmbPairSim} achieves up to 5.3 pp higher MRR than Sentence-BERT while using substantially fewer parameters. These results suggest that KGE representations can serve as compact and effective signals for graph-to-graph semantic similarity in KGs. Our code is available at https://github.com/SeungRyeolBaek/KG-to-KG-Semantic-Similarity.

</details>


### [411] [Evidence-Informed LLM Beliefs for Continual Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29182)
*Dhruv Agarwal,Reece Adamson,Andrew McCallum,Peter Clark,Ashish Sabharwal,Bodhisattwa Prasad Majumder*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对AutoDiscovery中使用静态贝叶斯惊奇度（Bayesian surprise）作为科学发现奖励信号的问题，提出使用非平稳惊奇度（non-stationary surprisal）——即基于证据更新的LLM信念来计算惊奇度。通过检索增强生成进行信念更新，过滤掉37.5%的虚假惊奇度，并结合信念更新过滤与多样性最大化两个改进，在五个发现领域平均提升非平稳惊奇度30.62%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（如AutoDiscovery）将惊奇度视为静态量，而人类推理中的惊奇度是非平稳的——它相对于随经验演化的信念而定义。这种静态处理方式无法支持持续的、渐进式的科学发现，需要引入基于证据更新的信念机制。

Method: (1) 使用嵌入检索增强生成（embedding-based RAG）从先前发现中检索证据来更新LLM信念；(2) 通过信念更新过滤（belief-update filtering）识别并剔除静态惊奇度中的虚假信号（占比37.5%）；(3) 引入多样性最大化（diversity maximization）策略来优化搜索过程。

Result: 在五个发现领域上，该方法相比原始搜索过程平均提升累积非平稳惊奇度30.62%；识别出37.5%的静态惊奇度为虚假信号。

Conclusion: 持续的LLM科学发现不仅需要更好的信念测量方法，还需要能够避免冗余、鼓励多样性的搜索程序。

Abstract: Open-ended scientific discovery with large language models (LLMs) increasingly operates as a long-horizon loop of hypothesis search and verification, where a reward signal guides which hypotheses to test next. A notable recent example is AutoDiscovery, which uses "Bayesian surprise" - the belief shift an LLM undergoes after observing evidence for a hypothesis - as both a discovery metric and a reward for search. We first observe that AutoDiscovery treats surprisal as a static quantity, while surprisal in human reasoning is non-stationary - it is defined relative to beliefs that evolve with experience, a prerequisite for continual scientific discovery. We address this mismatch with evidence-informed LLM beliefs: priors updated with evidence from previous hypotheses to compute non-stationary surprisal for new hypotheses. We compare in-context belief-updating mechanisms and find that embedding-based retrieval-augmented generation over prior discoveries best anticipates eventual posteriors, identifying 37.5% of static surprisals as spurious. We then modify search to avoid these spurious rewards and prioritize hypotheses that remain surprising under non-stationary beliefs. Concretely, we introduce two complementary changes to the original search procedure: belief-update filtering and diversity maximization. Across five discovery domains, our method increases accumulated non-stationary surprisal by 30.62% on average compared to the original search procedure, demonstrating that continual scientific discovery with LLMs requires not only better belief measurement but also search procedures that avoid redundancy and encourage diversity.

</details>


### [412] [AI Trading's Alpha Singularity: Emergent Market Reasoning through Agent-to-Agent Self-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29194)
*Yuqi Li,Siyuan Liu,Bingjun Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出密封联合搜索（SJS）框架，通过多智能体系统Agora实现可泛化的自动Alpha挖掘，在CSI 1000上取得Holdout夏普比率+1.87，显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定评分函数的自动Alpha挖掘会导致过拟合和泛化差距，需要将评分函数也作为搜索的一部分来避免自我确认偏差。

Method: 提出SJS框架，包含角色分解、类型化角色间通信、密封源读取、版本化存储、基底局部提升等结构条件；实现Agora系统，5类LLM智能体通过3个通道通信，进化8个技能库，3个评估者撰写报告而不投票。

Result: 在CSI 1000上运行100轮，91天2026年holdout上夏普比率+1.87；最佳基线+1.334（有利种子），跨种子均值-0.755；消融实验仅恢复+0.40的+2.25夏普差距；PPO无库进化反而扩大差距。

Conclusion: SJS框架能有效防止联合搜索中的自我确认偏差，产生可泛化的Alpha因子；两个度量指标是涌现而非设计的；但仍存在单种子运行、短期集中信号等局限。

Abstract: Automated alpha mining holds the scoring function fixed and varies the search algorithm over it. A search that converges against a fixed scorer overfits whatever the scorer cannot penalize, a primary cause of the out-of-sample generalization gap. We treat the scoring function as a search artifact alongside the alpha factors and study what conditions make this joint search admissible. Sealed Joint Search (SJS) is a framework: a set of structural conditions on information flow in an autonomous-discovery system that prevent joint search from collapsing into self-confirmation while keeping the evaluator sealed. Conditions cover role decomposition, typed inter-role communication, provenance-sealed reads, versioned stores, and substrate-local promotion. Agora tests SJS empirically: five LLM agent classes communicate via three channels, evolving eight skill libraries, with alpha libraries built on AlphaGen operators. Three evaluators write reports aggregated into one brief, carrying forward disagreement instead of voting. We run Agora for 100 rounds on CSI 1000 and evaluate on a 91-day 2026 holdout sealed from all LLM inputs. Agora achieves holdout Sharpe +1.87; best baseline +1.334 at favorable seed and -0.755 cross-seed mean. Pre-loading Agora's two metrics into a frozen-library ablation recovers only +0.40 of the +2.25 Sharpe gap, and adding PPO without library evolution worsens the gap. The two metrics emerge rather than being designed. Caveats: single-seed run, short-side concentrated signal, intended for long-short.

</details>


### [413] [A Cognition-Emotion-Personality Framework for Modeling Human-Like Awareness and Behavior in Emergency Evacuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29212)
*Zoi Lygizou,Michalis Zervas,Helena G. Theodoropoulou,Vasilis Zafeiropoulos,Dimitris Kalles,Chairi Kiourt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个整合认知、情感、社会与人格机制的扩展疏散模拟框架，通过事件不确定性感知、记忆驱动的出口知识、连续恐惧模型及OCEAN人格表征，在仿真实验中验证了这些因素对疏散效率、群体行为真实性的显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Agent的疏散模拟多依赖完美事件感知、完全出口知识与完全理性决策等理想假设，缺乏对认知局限、情感波动、社会影响和人格差异等真实人类因素的整合。

Method: 构建统一框架，包含：(1)基于连续事件确定性水平的动态事件感知机制；(2)基于记忆的出口知识表征（习得、遗忘与回忆）；(3)连续恐惧模型，恐慌作为高唤醒状态；(4)OCEAN人格模型，神经质与情感模型深度融合；(5)个体化的决策阈值。通过仿真实验评估空间熟悉度、记忆鲁棒性、决策敏感度、情感动态和人格差异的影响。

Result: 认知、情感和人格驱动过程显著影响疏散动态，降低疏散效率，产生延迟、混乱、受伤和社会性影响行为等真实人群现象。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了更真实的人类行为表征，支持系统研究认知、情感、人格与人群动态之间的相互作用。

Abstract: Agent-based evacuation simulations are widely used to study crowd behavior during emergencies, but many models rely on assumptions such as perfect event awareness, complete exit knowledge, and fully rational decision-making. This paper presents an extended evacuation framework that integrates cognitive, emotional, social, and personality-related mechanisms into a unified model of human behavior under uncertainty. The framework incorporates a dynamic event-awareness mechanism based on a continuous Event Certainty Level, a memory-based representation of exit knowledge subject to acquisition, forgetting, and recall, a continuous fear model in which panic emerges as a high-intensity state, and an OCEAN-based personality representation. Neuroticism is explicitly integrated into the emotional model, influencing fear generation, escalation, social contagion, and recovery. Behavioral heterogeneity is further captured through individualized decision thresholds that affect responses to perceived risk. The framework is evaluated through simulation experiments examining the effects of spatial familiarity, memory robustness, decision sensitivity, emotional dynamics, and personality variation. Results show that cognitive, emotional, and personality-driven processes substantially influence evacuation dynamics, reducing evacuation efficiency and generating realistic crowd phenomena such as delays, confusion, injuries, and socially influenced behaviors. The proposed framework provides a more realistic representation of human behavior in emergency evacuations and supports systematic investigation of the interactions between cognition, emotion, personality, and crowd dynamics.

</details>


### [414] [PolicyGuard: A Dialogue-Grounded Sub-Agent Verifier for Policy Adherence in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29225)
*Seongjae Kang,Taehyung Yu,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: POLICYGUARD是一个子代理验证器，通过共享对话上下文、自我推理策略并提供可操作反馈，在多轮对话中提升LLM代理的策略遵循能力。在tau²-BENCH基准上，PASS4指标提升+12.0/+6.0/+12.0个百分点，且违规召回率更高、阻断率仅为参数级守卫的一半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作将策略遵循视为外部检查的安全问题，但实际工作流涉及多轮对话、用户确认和前提阅读，需要全对话上下文、自我推理和对话级修复三个能力，而现有守卫工作低估了这些能力。

Method: 提出POLICYGUARD子代理验证器，共享代理的对话视图，在上下文中推理策略，为代理下一轮提供可操作反馈。

Result: 在tau²-BENCH航空领域，跨三个供应商（GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Pro）和四种设置下，PASS4提升+12.0/+6.0/+12.0个百分点。POLICYGUARD实现更高的策略违规召回率，阻断率约为参数级守卫的一半。

Conclusion: 策略遵循问题需要更全面的方法，POLICYGUARD通过对话级验证和可操作反馈有效提升了代理的策略遵循能力。

Abstract: LLM agents handle user requests on behalf of organizations through tool calls and must follow the company policies stated in their system prompts. Prior work approaches this as a safeguarding problem -- external checks that block non-compliant agent actions. We argue that policy adherence is a broader problem: real workflows unfold across many turns, require explicit user confirmation and prerequisite reads, and hinge on the content of the dialogue rather than on any single argument value. Meeting this bar requires (i) full conversation context, (ii) self-reasoning over the policy and the current dialogue, and (iii) conversation-specific remediation that guides the agent's next turn -- three capabilities that prior safeguard work has often underestimated. We introduce POLICYGUARD, a sub-agent verifier that shares the agent's view of the dialogue, reasons over the policy in context, and provides actionable feedback for the agent's next turn. On tau^2-BENCH airline across three vendors (GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro) with four trials per setting, POLICYGUARD improves PASS4 by +12.0 / +6.0 / +12.0 pp. Per-call analyses show POLICYGUARD achieves higher policy-violation recall while blocking roughly half as often as argument-level guards.

</details>


### [415] [SurgVLA-Bench: Towards Evaluating Vision-Language-Action Models for Laparoscopic Surgical Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29247)
*Jiashuo Sun,Yue He,Wenxuan Liu,Tao Mao,Jiazheng Wang,Xiang Chen,Min Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个面向腹腔镜手术机器人的VLA评估基准SurgVLA-Bench，通过层次化任务分类和多维评估框架，系统比较了自回归模型与流匹配模型在手术场景中的表现，发现两者各有优劣且整体性能远未满足临床需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA基准多面向通用机器人领域，缺乏专门针对手术机器人场景的标准化评估平台。

Method: 基于SurRoL仿真平台构建从原子动作到完整手术流程的层次化任务分类体系，设计同时评估动作精度与语义一致性的多维评估框架。

Result: 自回归模型（如OpenVLA）在语义理解上表现更好，流匹配模型（如π₀、π₀.₅、SmolVLA）在任务精度上更优但泛化性存在权衡；所有模型受限于内窥镜视野狭窄、视角受限和频繁遮挡等物理瓶颈。

Conclusion: SurgVLA-Bench填补了手术机器人VLA评估的空白，揭示了现有模型与临床需求之间的显著差距，指出了内窥镜物理约束是核心瓶颈。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models represent a promising direction for embodied intelligence in surgical robotics. Despite the prevalence of VLA benchmarks for general robotics, standardized evaluation platforms specifically designed for surgical contexts remain absent. To address this limitation, we present SurgVLA-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLA models in laparoscopic surgical robotics. Leveraging the SurRoL simulation platform, we construct a hierarchical task taxonomy ranging from atomic actions to complete surgical procedures, complemented by a multi-dimensional evaluation framework assessing action accuracy and semantic consistency. We then systematically evaluate two representative paradigms, including autoregressive models such as OpenVLA, and flow matching models such as $π_{0}$, $π_{0.5}$, and SmolVLA. Our experiments show that autoregressive models tend to excel in semantic understanding, while flow matching models often achieve higher task precision but may face generalization trade-offs. However, even the best-performing models remain far from satisfactory, as the constrained endoscopic field of view, restricted viewing angles, and frequent occlusions persist as fundamental physical bottlenecks. The code and data are available at https://github.com/VCL-HNU/SurgVLA

</details>


### [416] [When Summaries Distort Decisions: Information Fidelity in LLM-Compressed Financial Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29251)
*Hoyoung Lee,Suhwan Park,Seunghan Lee,Jun Seo,Jaehoon Lee,Sungdong Yoo,Minjae Kim,CheolWon Na,Zhangyang Wang,Zach Golkhou,Minkyu Kim,Sotirios Sabanis,Alejandro Lopez-Lira,Dhagash Mehta,Soonyoung Lee,Chanyeol Choi,Wonbin Ahn,Yongjae Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 金融决策者面临信息过载，需要压缩上下文。但LLM压缩金融材料时可能改变原始信息支持的投资判断。本文将此问题定义为信息保真度损失，分析了两种诊断模式（去情境化和模型依赖性），并提出了一种代理式上下文压缩方法，通过生成多个候选压缩并审计其与原始来源的差异来保持决策相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融决策者面对的信息量远超其可直接审查的范围，因此上下文压缩是必要的。然而，LLM在压缩金融源材料时可能改变原始信息所支持的投资判断，这一问题尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 1. 将压缩改变决策支持信息的问题定义为"信息保真度损失"；2. 分析两种保真度损失的诊断模式：去情境化（保留显著证据但丢失关键限定条件）和模型依赖性（不同压缩器呈现同一源材料的不同视角）；3. 提出代理式上下文压缩方法，生成多个候选压缩并审计其与原始来源的差异。

Result: 在金融文件和财报电话会议记录上，发现LLM压缩可以生成流畅且事实合理的压缩上下文，但仍然会改变下游决策。通过分析两种诊断模式，揭示了保真度损失的具体表现机制。

Conclusion: 金融上下文压缩不仅应关注效率和事实性，还应评估其保留决策相关上下文的能力。代理式上下文压缩通过多候选生成与审计机制，有助于在压缩过程中保持信息保真度。

Abstract: Financial decision-makers face more information than they can directly inspect, making context compression necessary. Yet when large language models (LLMs) compress financial source material, they can alter the investment judgment supported by the original source. We frame this problem as information fidelity: compression loses fidelity when it changes the decision induced by the source. In agentic systems, such losses may recur across intermediate steps and amplify throughout the decision process. Across financial filings and earnings-call transcripts, we find that LLM-based compression can produce fluent and factually plausible compressed contexts that nevertheless alter downstream decisions. We analyze two diagnostic patterns associated with fidelity loss: decontextualization, where salient evidence is retained but separated from the caveats and contextual qualifiers needed for correct interpretation, and model dependency, where different compressors expose different views of the same source. We then propose Agentic Context Compression, which generates multiple candidate compressions and audits their disagreements against the original source. Our results suggest that financial compression should be evaluated not only by efficiency or factuality, but also by its ability to preserve decision-relevant context.

</details>


### [417] [The Complexity Ceiling Benchmark: A Multi-Domain Evaluation of Sequential Reasoning Under Depth Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29278)
*Shubh Chapra,Dhruv Kumar,Murari Mandal,Yash Sinha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CCB基准测试通过控制任务语义内容、仅变化推理深度N∈{5,...,50}，在三种结构不同的推理场景（空间状态追踪、抽象符号指针操作、传递关系推理）中评估了语言模型推理能力随步骤增长而衰减的现象。在6000次试验中发现：几何级数衰减模式，不同领域天花板差异巨大；最强模型在前两个领域N=50时仍保持pd>0.92，但在传递关系推理领域N=5时即崩溃（最好模型50%成功步数H0.5≈4.7）；14.5%的正确答案通过错误中间推理得出；强制逐状态追踪不改变天花板；推理首次偏离的正确步数k*比参数量更能预测领域内准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对语言模型推理能力随推理链长度衰减的系统性、可控量化评估。已有工作混淆了任务语义复杂度与推理深度的影响，无法精确测量模型在纯深度维度上的推理退化曲线。

Method: 构建CCB基准：固定任务语义内容，仅变化推理深度N（5-50步），设计三个结构不同的推理领域（空间状态追踪、抽象符号指针操作、传递关系推理）。在5个前沿和开源LLM上进行6000次试验。引入TFBC（Trace-level Faithfulness Byproduct Check）指标检测正确结论背后的错误中间推理。提出几何衰减模型参数化描述推理退化曲线，定义H0.5（50%成功率对应的步数）和k*（推理首次偏离的正确步数）等指标。

Result: 最强模型在前两个领域N=50时pd>0.92；传递关系推理领域所有模型在N=5时即崩溃，最好模型H0.5≈4.7步；14.5%的正确答案通过错误中间推理得出（TFBC指标）；强制逐状态追踪不改变天花板（McNemar p=1.000）；k*比参数量更能预测领域内准确率。

Conclusion: CCB和几何衰减模型将模型的长程推理特征简化为每个任务族的一个可解释数值（H0.5或衰减率），揭示了推理深度的领域特异性天花板现象，以及模型"运气好"（错误推理得出正确答案）的普遍性。

Abstract: We introduce the Complexity Ceiling Benchmark (CCB), a controlled evaluation of how language-model reasoning decays as the number of required sequential steps grows. CCB fixes the semantic content of a task and varies only its depth N in {5,...,50} across three structurally distinct regimes: grounded spatial state-tracking, abstract symbolic pointer manipulation, and transitive relational inference. Across 6,000 trials over five frontier and open-weight LLMs we find a consistent pattern of geometric per-step decay with widely separated domain ceilings: on the first two regimes the strongest models retain pd>0.92 across N=50; on the third every model collapses by N=5, with the best model's 50%-success horizon at H0.5~4.7 steps despite pd=0.863. A trace-level metric (TFBC) shows that 14.5% of correct answers across the benchmark are reached via incorrect intermediate reasoning. Forced verbose state-tracking does not move the ceiling (McNemar p=1.000), and the mean step at which reasoning first diverges, k*, predicts within-domain accuracy better than parameter count. CCB and the geometric decay model together reduce a model's long-horizon reasoning profile to one interpretable number per task family.

</details>


### [418] [Process Advantage Signal Shaping: A Paradigm-Agnostic Middleware for Process-Supervised RL in LLM Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29296)
*Chao Wang,Hongtao Tian,Tao Yang,Yunsheng Shi,Ting Yao,Wenbo Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出现有的GRPO算法在融合过程监督信号时存在三种结构性问题（通道污染、分辨率不匹配、累积陷阱），并提出了PASS（过程优势信号整形）中间件，通过优势融合、按值分块、长度归一化三个策略来解决这些问题，在数学推理和多跳问答任务上持续超越GRPO基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO作为LLM推理器过程监督强化学习的默认方案，其过程监督信号在通过组标准化优势进行整合时存在三种结构性问题：1）组标准化时过程、结果、格式三个信号流之间的通道污染；2）过程信号粒度与逻辑决策粒度之间的分辨率不匹配；3）累积回报导致长度膨胀或截断探索的累积陷阱。

Method: 提出PASS中间件，包含三个核心组件：1）Advantage Fusion：将三个信号流在组内独立标准化，避免通道污染；2）Chunk-by-Value：基于信号自身生成值同质的分块，在分块内广播信用；3）Divide-Length：将累积目标转换为平均价值密度分数。

Result: 在数学推理（使用学习型PRM）和多跳问答（使用策略蒸馏KL信号及其泛化变体）两个领域、两种过程信号范式以及两种组标准化算子下，PASS在所有设置中均持续优于对应的GRPO基线（pass@1指标）。

Conclusion: PASS作为轻量级中间件能够有效修复GRPO在融合过程监督信号时的结构性问题，为过程监督强化学习提供了一种更稳定、更有效的信用分配方案。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a default recipe for process-supervised reinforcement learning of LLM reasoners, and dense process supervision -- via learned process reward models (PRMs) or on-policy-distillation KL signals -- is a common way to densify its otherwise weak outcome reward. Layering such a step-level signal on top of GRPO's group-standardized advantage, however, exposes three structural pathologies: \emph{channel contamination} between the pooled process, outcome, and format streams at group standardization; \emph{resolution mismatch} between the granularity of the process signal and the granularity of the logical decisions being credited; and a \emph{cumulative trap} by which GRPO's return-to-go sum surfaces either length inflation or truncated exploration depending on the sign regime of the signal. We propose \textbf{PASS} (\emph{Process Advantage Signal Shaping}), a compact middleware that sits between any scalar step-level process signal and GRPO's clipped surrogate and addresses the three pathologies in turn: \emph{Advantage Fusion} standardizes the three streams independently within each group, \emph{Chunk-by-Value} derives value-homogeneous chunks from the signal itself and broadcasts credit within each chunk, and \emph{Divide-Length} converts the cumulative objective into an average-value-density score. We validate PASS across two domains and two process-signal paradigms -- a learned PRM on mathematical reasoning and an on-policy-distillation KL signal (with a generalized variant) on multi-hop question answering -- and under two group-standardization operators. In every regime PASS delivers a consistent pass@1 gain over the corresponding GRPO baseline.

</details>


### [419] [Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29315)
*Abhranil Chandra,Sankaran Vaidyanathan,Utsav Dhanuka,Varun Gandhi,Scott Niekum*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HExA框架，通过在上下文中进行主动实验学习，使LLM智能体能够在复杂物理系统中自主设计实验、学习可复用技能并回答问题，无需训练或外部监督。在Interphyre基准测试中，HExA将Claude Sonnet 4.6的成功率从2%提升至77%，并展现出技能的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体依赖参数化知识、固定数据、检索或搜索，在面对无法从先验知识回答的新颖领域和复杂查询时表现不佳。仅仅知道物理定律不足以让LLM在复杂物理系统中完成长程任务。

Method: 提出Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents (HExA)，一种上下文中的自我改进框架。HExA通过迭代设计、优化查询相关实验，从经验中学习可复用的技能库，并整合实验证据来回答问题或采取行动。该框架无需训练，兼容任何黑盒模型，不需要外部监督、先验知识或离线数据。

Result: 在Interphyre基准测试中，当前LLM智能体表现不佳，Claude Sonnet 4.6仅2%成功率。HExA将同一模型提升至77%成功率，同时也提升了开源模型的性能，优于ReAct和Reflexion等基线方法。从简单关卡学习并迁移技能后，HExA达到44%成功率。

Conclusion: 通过主动实验学习能够帮助智能体发现有用知识、获取可复用技能，并在新颖的长程任务中取得高效进展。HExA证明了零训练、无需外部监督的上下文学习框架在复杂物理推理任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to take actions in the real world and support human decision-making, yet most agents rely on parametric knowledge, fixed post-training data, retrieval, or search. This paradigm breaks down in novel domains and for sophisticated queries that cannot be answered from prior knowledge alone. Knowing the laws of physics, for instance, does not by itself enable LLMs to answer queries or complete long-horizon tasks in a complex physical system. To address this, we introduce Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents (HExA), an in-context self-improvement framework to learn from active experimentation. HExA iteratively designs and refines query-relevant experiments, learns a reusable library of composable skills from experience, and integrates experimental evidence to answer queries or take actions. HExA is training-free, compatible with any black-box model, and does not require external supervision, oracles, or offline data. To evaluate active experimentation, we introduce Interphyre, a tool-calling benchmark built on the PHYRE 2D procedural physics environment, where agents propose interventions and test hypotheses through simulation APIs. Experiments show that current LLM agents struggle in these settings, especially on the hardest levels of Interphyre. Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieves only 2% success, while HExA improves the same model to up to 77% success. HExA also improves open-weight models and outperforms agentic baselines such as ReAct and Reflexion. Moreover, using only skills learned from easier levels and transferred without active experimentation, HExA achieves 44% success, demonstrating the reusability and generalization of its learned skills. Overall, HExA shows that learning through active experimentation can help agents discover useful knowledge, acquire reusable skills, and make efficient progress on novel long-horizon tasks.

</details>


### [420] [PHF: Privileged Hidden Flow for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29340)
*Yuhan Li,Mingxu Zhang,Dazhong Shen,Ying Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出特权隐藏流（PHF），在现有同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）基础上额外蒸馏教师模型的隐藏状态流动信息（包括逐token转移方向和轨迹几何结构），而非仅监督输出分布或逐点隐藏状态匹配。在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B上，PHF在相同100步训练下分别提升约+2.2、+1.5、+1.7个点（Average@12），且具有平移不变性和正交变换不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OPSD目标仅监督输出分布，特权上下文通过token级散度影响训练，但无法直接监督产生该分布的内部计算过程。作者希望将教师模型的隐藏状态流动信息（而非静态逐点匹配）蒸馏到学生模型中，以提供更丰富的内部监督信号。

Method: PHF在OPSD基础上额外对齐学生与教师在同一条轨迹上的隐藏状态流动：1）对齐token-to-token转移方向（transition directions）；2）对齐轨迹几何结构（trajectory geometry）；3）包含所有层的相邻层关系（adjacent-layer relation），源自相同转移方向但不进行逐点隐藏状态模仿。该传输目标精确不变于共享轨迹偏移，局部几何项不变于转移方向的正交变换。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B上，采用相同100步训练计划，PHF相比复现的OPSD基线在Average@12指标上分别提升约+2.2、+1.5、+1.7个点。消融实验区分了PHF与逐点隐藏状态匹配、单通道转移损失、层子集选择等变体的差异。

Conclusion: PHF作为一种紧凑的隐藏流动扩展，有效增强了OPSD的蒸馏效果，通过对齐隐藏状态的动态变化而非静态输出，提供了更丰富的内部监督，实验验证了其有效性和设计选择的重要性。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a reasoning model on rollouts sampled from its own policy by matching a privileged teacher that also sees verified reference solutions. Existing OPSD objectives supervise only the output distribution, so privileged context affects training through a token-level divergence without directly supervising the internal computation that produced that distribution. We propose Privileged Hidden Flow (PHF), which additionally distills how a privileged teacher's hidden states move along the same rollout. Rather than forcing each student hidden vector to match the teacher vector at the same token position, PHF aligns token-to-token transition directions and trajectory geometry over selected generated positions. The all-layer recipe also includes an adjacent-layer relation computed from these same transitions, without pointwise hidden-state imitation. Under the same 100-step training schedule, PHF improves the Average@12 aggregate over our reproduced OPSD baseline on Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, with observed gains of about +2.2, +1.5, and +1.7 points. The transport objective is exactly invariant to shared trajectory offsets; its local geometry term is also invariant to orthogonal transformations of transition directions. Ablations distinguish the fixed PHF recipe from pointwise hidden-state matching, single-channel transition losses, and layer-subset choices, supporting PHF as a compact hidden-flow extension to OPSD.

</details>


### [421] [When LLMs Develop Languages: Symbolic Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29354)
*Zhengqi Pei,Qingming Huang,Shuhui Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出通信语言符号路由(CLSR)框架，让多个LLM智能体自主发明和演化紧凑的符号化语言框架(LSF)，通过路由器自适应选择组合，在保持精度的同时将推理token数减少3-6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chain-of-Thought虽然能提升LLM在困难推理任务上的表现，但产生的长自然语言推理过程与高效机器推理不匹配，token开销大，需要一种更紧凑的符号化推理表示方法。

Method: CLSR框架包含：(1) 多个LLM智能体自主发明、演化并共享可复用的符号化协议(LSF)；(2) 无隐变量的路由器在推理时根据查询自适应选择/组合LSF，优化精度-token权衡；(3) 基于正确性和token成本的演化循环持续改进LSF。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的基准测试上，相比标准CoT，CLSR将面向延迟的生成token完成量减少3-6倍，同时保持精度不变。

Conclusion: CLSR通过符号化语言协议和自适应路由实现了高效的语言模型推理，从理论上推导了任意符号体系下的token成本信息论下界，并在可解释可实现前提下证明多轮LSF协议有条件地包含程序执行流水线。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves large language models (LLMs) on difficult reasoning tasks, but it often incurs long natural-language rationales that are poorly aligned with efficient machine reasoning. We propose Communicative Language Symbolism Routing (CLSR), a test-time framework in which multiple LLM agents autonomously invent, evolve, and share compact Language Symbolism Frameworks (LSFs), while a latent-free router adaptively selects and composes these languages per query to optimize the accuracy-token trade-off. Unlike prompt optimization that refines surface instructions, CLSR treats each LSF as a reusable symbolic protocol with compact symbols, usage rules, and a message-passing contract, and improves it through an evolutionary loop driven by correctness and token cost. At inference time, the router may invoke a single low-cost LSF call, ensemble multiple LSFs, or execute a multi-round LSF composition protocol on harder queries. Across challenging benchmarks, CLSR reduces latency-oriented generated token completion by $3\sim 6\times$ compared to standard CoT while maintaining accuracy. We further derive an information-theoretic lower bound on token cost under arbitrary symbolism and show that, under an interpreter-realizability premise, multi-round LSF protocols conditionally subsume program-execution pipelines. Code is publicly available (https://github.com/pzqpzq/LSF_MDia).

</details>


### [422] [Diagnosing and Repairing Factual Errors in RAG under Budget Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29377)
*Soroush Hashemifar,Havva Alizadeh Noughabi,Fattane Zarrinkalam,Ali Dehghantanha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: D2R-RAG是一种模型无关且资源感知的框架，通过可解释的故障诊断和自适应修复策略，在有限的延迟和显存约束下提升RAG系统的可靠性，在FEVER和HotpotQA数据集上实现了比现有方法更优的准确率-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统在实际部署中仍然脆弱，故障常源于缺失或弱相关的证据，以及生成结果未能忠实反映检索上下文。同时，许多现有方法依赖于微调、访问内部模型信号或资源不敏感的升级策略，在黑盒场景和预算受限场景下缺乏实用性。

Method: 提出D2R-RAG框架，从查询、检索证据和生成响应中提取可观测信号以推导可解释的故障签名，然后在显式的延迟和显存约束下从一组小的纠错动作中选择合适的修复策略。

Result: 在FEVER和HotspotQA数据集上，D2R-RAG相比近期基线方法提升了可靠性，并在多个计算预算下实现了更优的准确率-效率权衡。

Conclusion: D2R-RAG通过轻量级故障诊断与自适应修复相结合的方式，提供了一种实用、高效且可解释的RAG可靠性增强方案，适用于黑盒和资源受限的部署环境。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models by grounding responses in external evidence, yet real-world deployments remain fragile. Failures often stem from missing or weakly relevant evidence, as well as from generation that does not faithfully reflect the retrieved context. Many existing approaches rely on fine-tuning, privileged access to internal model signals, or resource-insensitive escalation strategies, which limits their practicality in black-box and budget-constrained settings. We propose D2R-RAG (Diagnose-to-Repair RAG), a model-agnostic and resource-aware framework that combines lightweight failure diagnosis with adaptive repair. D2R-RAG derives interpretable failure signatures from observable signals in the query, retrieved evidence, and generated response, and then selects from a small set of corrective actions under explicit latency and VRAM constraints. Experiments on FEVER and HotpotQA show that D2R-RAG improves reliability over recent baselines and achieves better accuracy--efficiency trade-offs across multiple compute budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/CyberScienceLab/D2R-RAG/.

</details>


### [423] [LLM-Guided Planning for Multi-hop Reasoning over Multimodal Nuclear Regulatory Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29399)
*Mingyu Jeon,Bokyeong Kim,Suwan Cho,Jae Young Suh,Yonggyun Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于LLM的规划型智能体，在无向量文档树上通过浏览、阅读和搜索工具进行多跳推理，并以动态知识图谱作为状态，在核安全分析报告上达到81.5%准确率，比无状态规划的基线提升38个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核监管文件审查需要跨数万页文档进行多跳推理，现有方法缺乏有效的规划机制来引导证据收集过程。

Method: 将核文件审查建模为规划问题：LLM智能体根据已收集证据动态选择下一个文档片段进行检查，利用浏览/阅读/搜索工具在无向量文档树上操作，并以动态知识图谱维护状态。

Result: 在200题基准上达81.5%准确率，RAGAS忠实度0.93；相比无状态规划的PageIndex提升38个百分点；优于LightRAG(73.0%)、HippoRAG(70.5%)和GraphRAG(49.5%)，与RAPTOR(75.5%)无显著差异且无需离线索引。7,391条推理边中仅0.04%标记为违规边界。

Conclusion: 规划能力是性能主导因素；边推理虽增加2.8倍成本但不提升准确率，可作为可追溯模块保留用于人工审计。

Abstract: Reviewing nuclear regulatory documents requires multi-hop reasoning across tens of thousands of pages, where judgments depend on evidence assembled across multiple chapters. We frame this task as planning: an LLM-based agent observes the evidence collected so far, picks the next document fragment to inspect, and stops when the evidence is sufficient. The agent operates over a vectorless document tree using browse, read, and search tools, and maintains a dynamic knowledge graph (KG) as state. On a 200-question benchmark over NuScale Final Safety Analysis Report (FSAR) documents, the system reaches 81.5% accuracy with a RAGAS Faithfulness of 0.93. The dominant performance factor is planning: against PageIndex, which uses the same document tree without state-conditioned action selection, the gap is +38.0pp (43.5% to 81.5%, p<0.001). The system also outperforms LightRAG (73.0%, p<0.05), HippoRAG (70.5%, p<0.01), and GraphRAG (49.5%, p<0.001), and matches RAPTOR (75.5%, p=0.11) without offline indexing. Edge inference adds 2.8x cost without raising accuracy; we retain it as a traceability module. Of 7,391 inferred edges, 3 Violates edges (0.04%) flag scope boundaries (Q058) and partial conformance (Q176) as typed annotations that a human reviewer can audit.

</details>


### [424] [Mixture of Debaters: Learn to Debate at Architectural Level in Multi-Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29425)
*Dayong Liang,Kaisong Gong,Yi Cai,Changmeng Zheng,Xiao-Yong Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Mixture of Debaters (MoD)框架，利用MoE范式在单模型内实现动态自我辩论，相比传统多智能体辩论方法，在降低3.7倍延迟和87% token消耗的同时取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于多智能体辩论的框架存在两大缺陷：1) 静态架构，智能体角色和协调模式在设计中固定；2) 需要实例化多个模型副本，导致计算开销过大。核心动机是设计一个更高效、动态的统一辩论框架。

Method: 提出了Mixture of Debaters框架，通过三个关键设计将MoE适配到辩证推理场景：1) 双路由机制，解耦角色分配与流程控制，动态决定何时辩论何时综合；2) 动量切换，利用局部上下文的token级路由平滑化，减少专家切换抖动；3) 统一自我辩论，将多样化的辩论人格封装为轻量级专家模块，在消除智能体间通信的同时保持行为多样性。

Result: 在多模态基准测试上，MoD在准确性上优于单模型基线和传统多智能体系统，同时延迟降低3.7倍，token消耗减少87%。

Conclusion: MoD通过单模型内动态自我辩论，有效解决了多智能体辩论框架的高开销和静态架构问题，实现了效率与性能的双重提升。

Abstract: Existing multi-agent debate frameworks suffer from two critical limitations: they rely on static architectures where agent roles and coordination patterns are fixed at design time, and they require instantiating multiple model copies, incurring substantial computational overhead. We propose Mixture of Debaters (MoD), a unified framework that enables dynamic self-debate within a single model by leveraging the Mixture-of-Experts paradigm. We address three key challenges in adapting MoE for dialectical reasoning: (1) dual-routing that decouples role allocation from process flow, dynamically determining when to debate versus when to synthesize; (2) momentum switching that smooths token-level routing with local context, reducing expert-switch jitter; and (3) unified self-debate that encapsulates diverse debating personas into lightweight expert modules, eliminating inter-agent communication while preserving behavioral diversity. Extensive experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that MoD outperforms both single-model baselines and conventional multi-agent systems, achieving superior accuracy with 3.7x lower latency and 87% reduction in token consumption.The source code can be accessed at https://github.com/YongLD/MoD.

</details>


### [425] [FADE: Mitigating Hallucinations by Reducing Language-Prior Dominance in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29431)
*Yichen Guo,Kai Tang,Fenglai Lin,Yiding Sun,Dongshuo Zhang,Wenya Wang,Lin William Cong,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发现LVLM中FFN模块是语言先验的来源，会导致幻觉，并提出FADE方法通过衰减FFN输出来减少语言先验主导，有效缓解幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLMs虽然能力强大但仍存在幻觉问题，即生成与输入图像不一致的内容。现有研究将幻觉归因于语言先验主导视觉输入，并采用对比解码方法缓解，但其机制根源尚未被探索。

Method: 通过分析每个Transformer层的信息流，发现注意力模块一致地聚合视觉证据，而关键层的FFN模块是语言先验的来源。基于此提出FADE（FFN Attenuation for DEcoding），一种无需训练的方法，通过衰减FFN输出来减少语言先验主导。

Result: 在POPE、CHAIR和MME基准上，对LLaVA-1.5、mPLUG-Owl2和InstructBLIP的评估显示，FADE有效缓解了幻觉，同时保持了推理效率。

Conclusion: FFN模块在关键层充当语言先验的来源，会覆盖视觉证据导致中间层的正确预测漂移为错误输出。FADE方法通过衰减FFN输出有效缓解幻觉，是一种无需训练的高效方法。

Abstract: Despite the impressive capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), they remain susceptible to hallucination, generating content inconsistent with the input image. Recent studies attribute this to the dominance of language priors over visual inputs and employ contrastive decoding methods to mitigate this dominance, but the mechanistic origin remains unexplored. We investigate the information flow through each transformer layer and find that attention modules consistently aggregate visual evidence, while FFN modules at critical layers act as the source of language priors. These priors can override visual evidence, causing correct predictions in intermediate layers to drift toward incorrect outputs. Based on this insight, we propose FADE (FFN Attenuation for DEcoding), a training-free method that attenuates FFN outputs to reduce language-prior dominance. Evaluations on POPE, CHAIR, and MME benchmarks across LLaVA-1.5, mPLUG-Owl2, and InstructBLIP show that FADE effectively mitigates hallucinations while preserving inference efficiency.

</details>


### [426] [How Much Due Diligence Before You Bid? Learning in Intractable Takeover Auctions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29457)
*Zain Naboulsi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过自对弈强化学习模型研究竞购战中尽职调查的价值，发现最优尽职调查投入是适度且有限的，竞争会侵蚀信息价值；同时验证了简单通用自对弈方法在复杂博弈中可媲美专用算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在两家公司竞购同一目标时，无人确切知道目标价值，每个竞标者需付费进行尽职调查以获取更精确的私人估值。核心问题在于：多少尽职调查投入才是值得的？

Method: 构建一个简单的计算机模型模拟竞购博弈，采用自对弈（self-play）方法让模型自我学习最优竞标策略，类似游戏引擎学习下棋的方式。通过控制竞标者携带的私人信息数量来调节问题复杂度，比较自对弈方法与专用精确算法的表现。

Result: 最优尽职调查投入是适度且有限的；投入随尽职调查成本上升而下降，且当双方都做尽职调查时进一步下降（因为竞争侵蚀了信息价值）。简单自对弈方法在游戏规模较小时不如专用精确算法，但在游戏规模大到无法精确求解时（即真实交易场景）能够找到强竞标策略。

Conclusion: 三类贡献：一种廉价且可复现的研究不确定性下交易的方法；一个基于模型的关于尽职调查价值的量化答案；以及轻型通用AI何时足以替代专用方法的经验证据。

Abstract: When two companies bid to buy the same target, no one knows exactly what the target is worth. Each bidder pays for due diligence: costly, imperfect homework that sharpens its own private estimate before it bids. How much of that homework is worth buying? We build a simple computer model of the bidding contest and let it teach itself to bid well by playing against itself, the way a game engine learns chess. The economic question, how much diligence pays for itself, and the computational question, when the contest becomes too complex to solve exactly, are both controlled by a single thing: how many pieces of private information a bidder carries. Our main finding is that the right amount of diligence is modest and finite. It falls as diligence gets more expensive, and it falls further when both sides are doing their homework, because competition erodes the value of knowing more. We also test a recent claim from AI research: that simple, general self-play methods can rival the specialized, expensive algorithms usually built for games like these. Running on an ordinary laptop with no costly frontier AI, we find the simple methods are the best of the self-learning approaches, though purpose-built exact methods still win whenever the game is small enough to solve outright. The simple methods earn their keep only once the game grows too large to solve exactly, which is the regime real deals live in, and there we show they still find strong bidding strategies. The contribution is threefold: a cheap, reproducible way to study deal-making under uncertainty; a concrete, model-based answer to how much due diligence is worth buying; and evidence about when lightweight, general-purpose AI is good enough to replace specialized methods. We release all the games, code, and experiments.

</details>


### [427] [Agent-Computer Observation Interfaces Enable Dynamic Computer Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29472)
*Bojie Li,Noah Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Agent-Computer Observation Interface (AOI)，一种将连续自适应观测与离散动作解耦的感知层，通过帧捕获、音频转录和视觉叙述三个门控组件，在DynaCU-Bench上使CU模型性能提升17-48个百分点，零重训练即可解决原本近乎不可能的任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前计算机使用（CU）代理将观测与动作紧密耦合（每3-5秒一张截图，无音频），导致代理在截图间隔期间对视频、动画、瞬态UI事件、会议和语音指令"又盲又聋"。作者类比SWE-agent中动作接口的设计思路，论证观测接口同样是一个未被充分探索的设计维度。

Method: 提出Agent-Computer Observation Interface (AOI)，一个与模型无关的感知层，包含三个门控组件：(1) 步间关键帧捕获，(2) 音量门控的音频转录，(3) CU模型生成的视觉叙述（持久化为文本）。每个组件在静态、无声内容上几乎不产生输出，退化为标准循环而不降低其性能。

Result: 在DynaCU-Bench（100个动态浏览器任务+50个静态控制任务）上，7B到前沿规模的CU模型相比截图基线提升17-48个百分点，无需重训练。音频任务上AOI代理解决所有任务；关键帧选择本身不重要，价值来自将捕获帧叙述为持久化文本；该接口不是固定组合，在Gemini 3 Flash上关键帧流因图像token稀释而退化，组件需按模型选择。

Conclusion: 解耦观测与动作、引入多模态持久化文本叙述能显著提升CU代理在动态场景下的能力；接口组件需根据具体模型适配而非统一配置。

Abstract: SWE-agent established the action interface as an underexplored design axis for software-engineering agents; we make the analogous case for the observation interface in computer-use (CU) agents. Current CU agents, closed and open-source alike, tie observation to action--one screenshot every 3-5 s, no audio--leaving them blind and deaf between screenshots to video, animations, transient UI events, meetings, and spoken instructions. We introduce the Agent-Computer Observation Interface (AOI), a model-agnostic perception layer that decouples continuous, adaptive observation from discrete actions through three gated components: inter-step keyframe capture, volume-gated audio transcription, and CU-model-generated visual narration that persists as text. Each produces almost nothing on static, silent content, reducing to the standard loop without degrading it.
  On DynaCU-Bench (100 dynamic browser tasks plus a 50-task static control), CU models from 7B to frontier scale gain +17 to +48 pp over their screenshot baselines with zero retraining, turning tasks that are near-impossible from periodic screenshots into largely solved ones. The gap is starkest on audio: on a spoken-content subset AOI agents solve every task, whereas streaming voice models hear accurately but cannot act on what they hear without the scaffold. The decomposition is as informative as the headline gain: keyframe selection turns out not to matter--the value comes from narrating captured frames into persistent text--and the interface is not a fixed bundle, since on a newer model (Gemini 3 Flash) the keyframe stream actively regresses through image-token dilution, so its components must be selected per model rather than shipped as one configuration.

</details>


### [428] [Faults in Our Formal Benchmarking: Dataset Defects and Evaluation Failures in Lean Theorem Proving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29493)
*Pawan Sasanka Ammanamanchi,Siddharth Bhat,Stella Biderman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对五个广泛使用的Lean定理证明基准测试进行了系统性审计，发现了4,833个问题（包括398个机械可验证的缺陷，如反例、空洞定理和不可靠公理），并提出了故障分类体系、自动化检查工具和数据集发布标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Lean定理证明基准测试虽然具有机器可验证的形式化证明，但内核仅检查证明是否建立了形式化陈述，并未验证该陈述是否忠实编码了原始非形式化问题，也未评估框架对平凡解或对抗性解的鲁棒性。因此，这些基准测试的可靠性存在隐患，需要系统性审计和修复。

Method: 使用大规模静态检查器对五个广泛使用的Lean定理证明基准测试及其衍生版本进行审计，结合面向召回率的语义审核提示，发现并分类机械可验证的缺陷和语义缺陷。在修正后的子集上评估缺陷对证明器得分的影响。

Result: 发现了4,833个问题，包括398个机械可验证的缺陷（如反例、空洞定理和不可靠公理）以及若干语义缺陷（如缺失假设、问题简化、翻译不完整或不正确、Lean特有的规范风险）。缺陷既能虚增也能降低证明器的报告得分。

Conclusion: 提出了故障分类体系、自动化检查工具和数据集发布标准，以指导形式化数学数据集的创建，并使评估更加可复现和可信。

Abstract: Benchmarks for LLM-assisted theorem proving in Lean are often treated as intrinsically reliable because every solved instance comes with a machine-checked proof. However, the kernel only checks that a proof establishes a \emph{formal} statement; it does not verify that the statement faithfully encodes the intended informal problem, nor that evaluation harnesses are robust to trivial or adversarial solutions. We audit five widely used Lean theorem-proving benchmarks and their forks, using corpus-scale static checkers to surface 4,833 findings, including 398 mechanically certified issues such as counterexamples, vacuous theorems, and unsound axioms. We also document semantic defects such as missing hypotheses, problem simplification, incomplete or incorrect translations, and Lean-specific specification hazards. Beyond dataset construction, we survey evaluation-time failure modes and show, on corrected subsets, that defects can both inflate and deflate reported prover scores. We propose a fault taxonomy, a suite of automated checkers and recall-oriented semantic audit prompts, and release standards to guide the creation of formal math datasets and to make evaluation more reproducible and trustworthy. Our checkers, audit prompts, and corrected dataset snapshots are available at https://github.com/Shashi456/atp-checkers.

</details>


### [429] [Cognitive World Models for Process-Level Social Influence Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29495)
*Minghui Ma,Bin Guo,Han Wang,Mengqi Chen,Jingqi Liu,Yan Liu,Zhiwen Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CogWM，一个基于LLM的认知世界模型，通过预测用户认知状态（信念、欲望、意图、情感）来评估社交影响力对话，将评价标准从“用户说了什么”转向“用户内部认知状态如何演化”，在三层评估框架下优于传统指标和GPT-5.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话评估指标（BLEU/ROUGE）和LLM单次评分无法捕捉用户内部认知状态（信念、欲望、意图、情感）在对话过程中的动态变化，而社交影响力对话的核心目标正是通过改变用户认知状态来改变行为，因此需要过程导向的评估方法。

Method: 提出CogWM框架：1) 联合预测BDI/E认知状态和用户话语；2) 作为用户模拟器和评估平台；3) 采用三层评估体系（轮次级保真度、轨迹级状态动力学、任务级复合评分）。通过Summarize-and-Allocate (SaA)标注流程，在150,454用户样本上训练，涵盖四种社交影响力场景。

Result: CogWM在情感准确率上达到77.6%，是GPT-5.5的2.1倍。在3600次多智能体区分试验中，能有效区分六种商业智能体的认知影响力，Llama-4-Scout排名第一（CTS +0.233）。

Conclusion: CogWM将社交影响力对话评估从终端判断转向过程跟踪，为评估对话系统对用户认知状态的真实影响提供了更有效的框架。

Abstract: Social influence dialogue changes user behavior by altering internal cognitive states. The central evaluation question is whether the user's beliefs, desires, intentions, and emotions measurably change over the course of conversation, a process-oriented criterion that neither surface-level text metrics (BLEU/ROUGE) nor single-score LLM judgments can capture. We propose the \textbf{Cog}nitive \textbf{W}orld \textbf{M}odel \textbf{(CogWM)}, an LLM-based user model that reframes multi-turn dialogue evaluation from ``what did the user say'' to ``how did the user's internal cognitive state evolves.'' CogWM jointly predicts BDI/E cognitive states and user utterances and serves as both a user simulator and an evaluation platform, using a three-tier evaluation framework that covers turn-level fidelity, trajectory-level state dynamics, and task-level composite scoring. Trained via our \textbf{S}ummarize-\textbf{a}nd-\textbf{A}llocate \textbf{(SaA)} annotation pipeline on 150,454 user-turn samples across four social influence scenarios, CogWM achieves 77.6\% emotion accuracy (2.1$\times$ over GPT-5.5). In 3600 multi-agent discrimination trials, it distinguishes six commercial agents by their cognitive influence, with Llama-4-Scout ranking first (CTS +0.233). CogWM moves social influence dialogue evaluation from terminal judgment to process tracking. We have released our code\footnote{\scriptsize Code: https://github.com/lucianma05-create/CogWM} and models\footnote{Model: https://www.modelscope.cn/models/LucianMa/CogWM-14B}.

</details>


### [430] [UCOB: Learning to Utilize and Evolve Agentic Skills via Credit-Aware On-Policy Bidirectional Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29502)
*Songjun Tu,Chengdong Xu,Qichao Zhang,Yiwen Ma,Yaocheng Zhang,Linjing Li,Dong Li,Xiangyuan Lan,Dongbin Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UCOB框架通过信用感知的在线双向自蒸馏方法，利用回报比较让智能体学会何时采纳、何时纠正技能记忆中的经验，从而提升强化学习在智能体任务中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能记忆方法假设技能条件提示可作为固定教师（privileged teacher），但检索到的技能并非全知全能——在同一任务中，技能可能对某个状态有帮助，却对另一个状态产生误导。这一假设的脆弱性导致了次优策略。

Method: 提出UCOB框架，核心为信用感知的在线双向自蒸馏：将技能条件提示和无技能提示视为同一模型的两个在线上下文视图，在同一任务和锚定状态下比较它们的预期回报（return-to-go），以回报较高的视图作为局部教师。通过该局部信用信号内化有用技能行为、纠正误导性技能使用，并指导技能记忆更新、效用感知检索和反思自训练。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA等智能体任务上，UCOB超越无技能RL、技能记忆基线和自蒸馏方法，在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别比SOTA基线高出23.5和18.0个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过消融和分析实验验证了UCOB核心机制的有效性和效率，说明信用感知的双向对比蒸馏是处理技能记忆中非全知经验的有效范式。

Abstract: Skill memories can improve agentic reinforcement learning by reusing past experience as textual guidance, but retrieved skills are not oracular: they may help in one state while misleading the same policy in another. This makes the common privileged-teacher assumption fragile, namely that a skill-conditioned prompt can be treated as a fixed teacher for the no-skill prompt. We introduce UCOB, a framework for learning to utilize and evolve agentic skills via credit-aware on-policy bidirectional self-distillation. UCOB treats skill-conditioned and no-skill prompts as two on-policy context views of the same model, compares their return-to-go within the same task and anchor state, and uses the higher-return view as the local teacher. This local credit signal internalizes useful skill-conditioned behavior, corrects misleading skill usage, and guides task/state skill memory updates, utility-aware retrieval, and reflection self-training. Experiments on agentic tasks, including ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA, show that UCOB outperforms skill-free RL, skill-memory baselines, and self-distillation methods across model scales, with up to 23.5 and 18.0 point gains over SOTA baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop. Ablations and analyses further validate its core mechanisms and efficiency.

</details>


### [431] [OSWorld2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29537)
*Mengqi Yuan,Zilong Zhou,Xinzhuang Xiong,Weiming Wu,Jiayang Sun,Jiamin Song,Kaiqian Cui,Bowen Wang,Haoyuan Wu,Yitong Li,Dunjie Lu,Haikong Lu,Qi Zhen,Xinyuan Wang,Jiaqi Deng,Yuhao Yang,Cheng Chen,Boyuan Zheng,Alex Su,Xiao Yu,Hao Zou,Saaket Agashe,Xing Han Lu,Manpreet Kaur,Zhengyang Qi,Vincent Sunn Chen,Frederic Sala,Dayiheng Liu,Junyang Lin,Zhou Yu,Yu Su,Siva Reddy,Xin Eric Wang,Peng Qi,Tianbao Xie,Tao Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OSWorld 2.0 是一个包含108个长时程计算机使用工作流的基准测试（中位完成时间约1.6小时，平均需318次工具调用），旨在捕捉真实世界计算机使用的复杂性。在500步二元完成指标下，Claude Opus 4.8 仅完成20.6%的任务，表明当前智能体远未达到专业级计算机使用水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机使用基准未能捕捉真实世界的复杂性、真实性和长时程需求，限制了揭示前沿智能体局限性的能力。

Method: 设计了108个跨日常和专业任务的长时间工作流，目标覆盖流式交互、动态环境、跨源推理、隐式状态推断和视觉空间精度等挑战现象，任务基于真实输入工件和状态性用户档案数据，并包含安全审计报告。

Result: Claude Opus 4.8 在500步二元完成指标下仅完成20.6%的任务（部分得分54.8%），GPT-5.5 约13%。智能体主要在约束追踪、中段信息获取、用户询问、验证步骤等方面失败，尤其难以处理需要恢复隐藏状态的任务。

Conclusion: 当前智能体远未达到专业级计算机使用水平，主要瓶颈不在于基本GUI控制或编程，而在于高层认知能力如约束追踪、信息整合和隐式状态推理。

Abstract: Existing computer-use benchmarks fail to capture the realism, complexity, and long-horizon demands of real-world computer use, limiting their ability to reveal the limitations of frontier agents. We introduce OSWorld 2.0, a benchmark of 108 long-horizon computer-use workflows across everyday and professional tasks, designed to capture complex and challenging real-world phenomena. Each task represents a realistic end-to-end workflow that takes human users a median of about 1.6 hours to complete and requires an average of 318 tool calls with Claude Opus 4.7 using maximum thinking, compared with about 30 in OSWorld 1.0. OSWorld 2.0 targets challenge phenomena that are common in real workflows yet underrepresented in prior benchmarks, spanning interaction-design challenges such as streaming interaction and dynamic environments, as well as agent-pattern challenges such as cross-source reasoning, implicit-state inference, and visual-spatial precision. Tasks are grounded in authentic input artifacts and cross-referenced against realistic stateful user profile data, and include separate safety reports auditing safety-sensitive execution. Under our primary binary-completion metric at 500 steps, Claude Opus 4.8 with maximum thinking and batched tool calls scores best but still completes only 20.6% of tasks at a 54.8% partial score; GPT-5.5 is far more token-efficient yet plateaus near 13%. These results show that current agents are still far from professional-level computer use: rather than stumbling on basic GUI control or coding, they lose track of constraints, miss information that arrives mid-task, guess rather than ask the user, and skip verification, struggling most when a task hinges on hidden state they must recover.

</details>


### [432] [Learned Coordination Conventions in Cooperative MARL: Measuring the Translation Gap Between Theory-Informed Roles and Learned Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29541)
*Yoosung Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了合作多智能体强化学习（MARL）中理论预期的角色语义先验与实际学习到的协调结构之间的差异，提出了一个包含角色路由矩阵、形成敏感度（Δ_max）和梯度/遮挡归因的诊断框架，并在MiniGrid和SMACv2环境中验证了标签条件注意力机制相比MLP基线能产生更集中、稳定的角色路由，且零样本迁移到不同团队规模，同时揭示了小样本噪声可能造成虚假的策略分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合作MARL系统通过去中心化、非平稳学习形成协调惯例，但无法保证学习到的结构匹配理论预设的角色语义先验，两者之间存在翻译差距（translation gap），目前缺乏系统性的测量框架来评估这种差异。

Method: 提出一个三组件诊断框架：(1) 角色路由矩阵（role-routing matrix）用于表征智能体间的角色分配；(2) 形成敏感度Δ_max用于量化协调结构的稳定性；(3) 梯度/遮挡归因用于分析角色特异性。在三种角色的MiniGrid和SMACv2（Terran）环境中，比较标签条件注意力网络（label-conditioned attention）与扁平MLP基线的表现。

Result: 标签条件注意力产生了更集中和角色特定的路由，在3v3到9v9的规模扩展中保持稳定，能零样本迁移到不同团队大小，且对盟友槽位填充具有不变性。5种子重评估显示学习到的惯例与设计者指定的先验部分对齐，同时揭示了小样本噪声可能制造出虚假的战略分歧。

Conclusion: 本文提出的框架是一个用于测量合作MARL中协调结构的实证工具，而非新的均衡概念或因果解释，有助于弥合理论角色预期与学习到的协调结构之间的差距。

Abstract: Role-semantic assignments provide priors over how heterogeneous agents may coordinate, but cooperative MARL systems instead settle on conventions through decentralized, non-stationary learning, with no guarantee that the resulting structure matches those priors. We study this translation gap between theory-informed role expectations and learned coordination structure through a diagnostic combining a role-routing matrix, formation sensitivity ($Δ_{\max}$), and gradient/occlusion attribution across three-role MiniGrid and SMACv2 (Terran) environments.
  We show that label-conditioned attention produces substantially more concentrated and role-specific routing than flat MLP baselines, remains stable under 3v3--9v9 scaling, transfers zero-shot across team sizes, and is invariant to ally-slot padding. A 5-seed re-evaluation shows partial alignment between learned conventions and designer-specified priors while revealing where small-n noise can manufacture apparent strategic divergence. We present these results as an empirical framework for measuring coordination structure in cooperative MARL rather than as a new equilibrium concept or causal explanation.

</details>


### [433] [SCARCE: Scalable Cascade Analysis for Rare-event Characterisation via Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29623)
*Yingjie Wang,Yi Dong,Edmund Lau,Jie Meng,Taylor T Johnson,Xiaowei Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SCARCE 是一种基于学习表示和几何度量的新型子集模拟方法，用于高效估计AI系统（如LLM越狱）中的罕见事件概率，在MNIST分类和Llama-Guard-3-8B越狱检测中比传统方法精度提升400-500倍且无需手工设计性能函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统的安全评估受限于罕见事件概率估计的样本效率瓶颈——直接蒙特卡洛方法需要庞大样本预算。传统子集模拟虽然能降低样本需求，但依赖手工设计的标量性能函数，需要预先知道失效几何结构，限制了在新领域的迁移能力。

Method: SCARCE 用学习到的潜在表示和几何度量（rulers）替代传统性能函数，通过自适应阈值构建嵌套中间事件。形式化上利用非负鞅（supermartingale）推导高概率上界，支持早停。对于LLM越狱，使用PCA降维后的隐状态作为ruler，并引入KL散度作为ruler质量的排序准则。

Result: 在MNIST误分类场景，SCARCE 的MAE比网格搜索的传统SS低400-500倍，且消除系统性的过计数。在Llama-Guard-3-8B的PAIR风格越狱检测中，PCA-based ruler在η≥10⁻³时平均相对误差2.6%（参考半宽27.9%），迁移至GCG风格语料仅需重校准后误差2.93%。KL散度准则与估计误差的Spearman相关系数为0.83。

Conclusion: SCARCE 有效克服了传统子集模拟对领域知识的依赖，通过数据驱动的方式实现了罕见事件概率的准确、可迁移估计，为AI系统安全评估提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Rare events govern the safety profile of modern AI systems, yet their probabilities are extremely difficult to estimate: direct Monte Carlo requires prohibitive sample budgets. Subset Simulation (SS) addresses this by decomposing a rare-event probability into moderate conditional probabilities over nested intermediate events. However, classical SS requires a handcrafted scalar performance function whose sublevel sets define those events, demanding detailed knowledge of the failure geometry and limiting transfer to new domains. We propose SCARCE (Scalable Cascade Analysis for Rare-event Characterisation via Embeddings), which replaces the performance function with learned latent representations and geometric rulers that score proximity to failure regions. Adaptive thresholding constructs nested intermediate events directly from data. We formalise SCARCE through a non-negative supermartingale, yielding a high-probability upper envelope that remains valid under early stopping. On MNIST misclassification, where dense Monte Carlo provides ground truth, SCARCE achieves approximately 400--500 times lower mean absolute error than grid-searched traditional SS while eliminating systematic over-counting. We then study PAIR-style LLM jailbreaks under a fleet-level threat model with adversarial fraction $η$. On Llama-Guard-3-8B hidden states, a PCA-based ruler attains 2.6% mean relative error for $η\geq 10^{-3}$ against finite-sample references whose average bootstrap relative half-width is 27.9%, and transfers to a GCG-style corpus with 2.93% relative error after recalibration. A directional criterion $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{good}}\,\|\,p_{\mathrm{bad}})$ ranks rulers consistently with estimation error (Spearman $ρ=0.83$).

</details>


### [434] [SFBench: The SciFy Scientific Feasibility Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29630)
*Cash Costello,James Mayfield,Elsbeth Turcan,Christine Piatko,Christina K. Pikas,Justin Rokisky,Sam Scheck,Chris Ribaudo,Ritwik Bose,Alex Memory*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SFBench是一个评估科学主张可行性判断系统的基准数据集，包含197条材料科学领域的主张，每条标注了五分量表可行性评分及解释。该数据集由领域专家构建，非从现有论文提取或AI生成，采用开放式解释，显著降低了LLM预训练记忆风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准数据集多基于现有科学出版物提取主张，LLM可能已训练过这些数据；且多数采用固定答案格式（如多项选择），无法充分评估复杂科学推理能力。SFBench旨在填补这一空白，提供一个更严格的科学主张可行性评估测试集。

Method: 1) 由材料科学领域专家从头创建197条科学主张，而非从文献中提取；2) 每条主张由多名专家标注五分量表可行性评分及开放式解释；3) 定义评估指标；4) 使用GPT系列模型建立基线结果。

Result: 论文描述了基准设计、数据创建过程和评估指标，并报告了使用最新GPT模型的基线实验结果。

Conclusion: SFBench提供了一个更具挑战性的科学主张可行性评估基准，具有高新颖性和领域专家验证的可靠性，为评估LLM在科学推理任务上的能力提供了新的测试平台。

Abstract: We present SFBench, a benchmark dataset for evaluating systems that assess the feasibility of scientific claims. SFBench includes 197 claims in materials science, each annotated with a ground-truth feasibility score on a five-point scale along with an explanation of that assessment. The collection differs from previous collections in several important ways: 1) it defines a complex task that requires reasoning over claims of varying scientific feasibility; 2) its claims are not extracted from existing scientific publications but are created de novo, greatly reducing the chances that LLMs have trained on them; 3) claims and ground truth are established by subject matter experts, not by artificial intelligence; and 4) unlike many benchmarks that ask about question/answer pairs, provide multiple choice answers, or ask questions requiring short, fixed answers, SFBench explanations are completely open-ended. We describe the benchmark design, data creation process, and evaluation metrics, and we report baseline results using recent GPT models.

</details>


### [435] [Budgeted Act-or-Defer Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation with Local Reliability Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29654)
*Mengdie Flora Wang,Haochen Xie,Guanghui Wang,Devin Zhang,Jae Oh Woo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于预算的“行动或推迟”决策框架，用于多智能体LLM辩论系统。通过k近邻置信下限将对话前缀映射到低维状态，仅在可靠性超过用户指定阈值时才采取行动，并利用分解公式β=δ+α+ε_act控制错误行动。该方法在六个基准测试中仅使用9-12%的预算，自动化率达84%，准确率96%，并在压力测试中主动推迟而非强制自动化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM辩论虽能提升推理能力，但实际部署中需要决定何时回答足够可靠可执行、何时应升级到人工审查。现有方法缺乏对错误行动的事前可控保证，且不同难度任务下相同绝对错误预算意义不同，需要一种能在部署前根据用户声明的错误预算转化为可靠行动决策点的方法。

Method: 将问题形式化为预算约束下的“行动或推迟”决策。每轮将辩论前缀映射到低维状态，利用校准数据计算k近邻状态条件正确率的置信下限。仅当置信下限超过用户指定的可靠性阈值时才行动。通过分解β=δ+α+ε_act控制错误行动，分别对应校准失败、残余行动风险和表征差距。预算相对于每个任务最终轮错误的相对比例设定，利用训练数据计算。配套提供了每个假设的伪造风格诊断工具。

Result: 在六个基准测试中，与九种基线方法对比，该方法在激活数据集上仅使用9-12%的预声明预算，自动化率最高达84%，行动准确率达96%。在压力测试数据集中，方法选择推迟而非强制不可靠的自动化。无需每个任务的事后阈值搜索，即可在部署前将用户声明的错误行动预算转化为可审计的行动或推迟操作点。

Conclusion: 该方法能够在明确假设下，在部署前将用户声明的错误预算转化为可审计的行动决策点，避免了对每个任务进行事后阈值搜索的需求。通过相对预算设定解决了不同难度任务间绝对预算意义不一致的问题，并提供了假设检验的诊断工具以确保可审计性。

Abstract: Multi-agent deliberation among LLMs can improve reasoning, but deployment requires deciding when the current answer is reliable enough to act on and when it should be escalated to human review. We formulate this as budgeted act-or-defer decision making. At each round, the system maps the debate prefix to a low-dimensional state, computes a $k$-nearest-neighbor lower confidence bound on state-conditional correctness using calibration data, and acts only when the bound exceeds a user-specified reliability threshold. The certificate controls wrong actions through the decomposition $β= δ+ α+ \varepsilon_{\mathrm{act}}$, separating calibration failure, residual action risk, and representation gap. The guarantee is conditional, not distribution-free: it relies on a valid local bias envelope and an action-region representation-gap bound, and each assumption is paired with falsification-style diagnostics. Because the same absolute wrong-action budget has different meanings across tasks of different difficulty, we set budgets relative to each task's final-round error using training data only, and evaluate safety by normalized budget usage $\mathrm{WA}/β$. On six benchmarks against nine baselines, the method uses 9--12% of the pre-declared budget on activated datasets, reaching up to 84% automation and 96% acted-on accuracy; on stress-test datasets, it defers rather than forcing unreliable automation. Rather than relying on per-task post-hoc threshold search, the method prospectively converts a user-declared wrong-action budget into an auditable act-or-defer operating point before deployment, under explicitly stated assumptions.

</details>


### [436] [Safety from Honesty in a Disinterested AI Predictor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29657)
*Yoshua Bengio,Oliver Richardson,Tomáš Gavenčiak,Michael Cohen,Rory Svarc,Damiano Fornasiere,Gael Gendron,David Hyland,Aton Kamanda,Adam Oberman,Francis Rhys Ward,Anna Gavenčiak,Jacob Livingston Slosser,Vincent Mai,Iulian Serban,Joumana Ghosn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对Scientist AI Predictor的形式化安全论证，该预测器通过训练近似贝叶斯后验来预测行动与后果，但本身不成为具有目标导向行为的智能体。通过认知语境化数据表示和后验训练目标，将目标表达视为待解释的证据而非模型采纳的驱动，并确保训练中不使用下游效果作为奖励信号。论文证明，在特定假设下，产生危险预测器的概率可控制在指定阈值以下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI系统能力增强，为优化下游结果而设计的训练流程可能引入隐式能动性——即设计者从未指定的目标导向行为。现有方法缺乏对这种非意图智能体涌现的正式安全保障。

Method: 1) 认知语境化数据表示：区分潜在事实主张与交流行为，将目标表达视为需解释的证据；2) 后验逼近训练目标：驱动模型产生校准且谨慎的预测；3) 去奖励化训练：下游部署效果不构成训练奖励信号；4) 显式支架与防护栏约束；5) 形式化概率论证：基于训练动力学假设和危险预测器的稀疏性假设，证明危害概率有上界。

Result: 证明了在训练动力学假设和危险预测器稀疏性假设下，产生残余危害超过指定阈值的预测器的概率很小。危险预测器需在大量查询上协调一致地低估危害，而这种协调模式在初始化分布下稀缺且不受直接训练信号支持。

Conclusion: 安全性与准确性在该框架中共同得到支持——保障准确性的约束同时也使协调欺骗代价高昂。该保证不排除预测器被用作智能系统的一部分。

Abstract: As AI systems become more capable, training procedures that optimize for downstream outcomes risk introducing implicit agency: goal-directed behavior that designers never specified. We present a formal safety argument for the Scientist AI (SAI) Predictor, trained to approximate the Bayesian posterior conditioned on a dataset of "epistemically contextualized" natural-language statements. We argue that such a Predictor can honestly predict agents, actions, and their consequences without itself being an agent that selects outputs to achieve goals. This rests on data representation and on the training procedure. Epistemic contextualization of text distinguishes latent factual claims from communication acts, so expressions of goals are treated as evidence to be explained rather than drives the model adopts. With a posterior-seeking training objective, this is intended to drive the Predictor toward calibrated, cautious predictions. Training proceeds so downstream effects of deploying a prediction never serve as a reward signal; any agency the system needs is supplied by explicit scaffolding constrained by guardrails. We prove that, under assumptions on the training dynamics and on the argued sparsity of dangerous Predictors, the probability that training produces a Predictor whose guarded deployment carries residual harm above a specified threshold is small: a dangerous Predictor would have to underestimate harm in a coordinated way across many queries while such coordinated patterns are rare under the initialization distribution and receive no direct training signal. Safety and accuracy are jointly supported in this framework, since the constraints that secure accuracy are the same ones that make coordinated deception costly. These guarantees against misalignment and agency arising from within the Predictor itself do not preclude the use of the Predictor as part of an agentic system.

</details>


### [437] [Diversity is the Strength of the AI Crowd](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29661)
*Matthew Aitchison,Scott Jeen,Toby Shevlane,Ben Day*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 顶级AI预测系统已接近超级预测者水平，但主要依赖现成LLM加预测专用上下文收集和脚手架。研究发现，通过集成提高预测准确性的关键在于结合准确但多样化的预测模型，而非单纯增加采样数量。Grok 4等模型因与其它前沿LLM相关性较低而贡献巨大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前顶级AI预测系统已接近超级预测者精度，但主要依赖现成LLM结合专用上下文收集和脚手架。研究旨在探索如何通过集成方法优化这一方案：在固定采样数下，如何组合现成模型预测以最大化准确性。

Method: 在Metaculus AI基准测试的二元问题上，通过比较不同前沿LLM的预测结果，分析个体准确性、预测相关性对集成效果的影响，评估Grok 4等模型的贡献。

Result: 个体准确性不足以保证集成效果；许多前沿LLM的预测高度相关，限制了同类模型额外预测的价值。最强的集成方案需结合准确但多样化的预测器，其中Grok 4因与其它前沿LLM的相关性较低而贡献不成比例。

Conclusion: AI集成的优势不在于盲目增加采样数量，而在于结合具有互补误差的不同模型。这启示预测系统应同时优化模型质量和多样性。

Abstract: Top AI forecasting systems are approaching superforecaster-level accuracy on future world events, but still rely primarily on off-the-shelf LLMs combined with forecasting-specific context gathering and scaffolding. We study how to improve this recipe through ensembling: given a fixed number of samples, which off-the-shelf model forecasts should be combined to maximize accuracy? On binary questions from the Metaculus AI Benchmark, we find that individual accuracy is not enough: many frontier LLMs make highly correlated predictions, limiting the value of additional forecasts from the same or similar models. Instead, the strongest ensembles combine accurate but diverse forecasters, with models such as \model{Grok 4} contributing disproportionately because their predictions are less correlated with other frontier LLMs. These results suggest that the strength of the AI crowd comes not from sampling more forecasts indiscriminately, but from combining forecasts across models with complementary errors, motivating forecasting systems that explicitly optimize for both model quality and diversity.

</details>


### [438] [Sample-Efficient Learning of Probabilistic Causes for Reachability in Markov Decision Processes with Probabilistic Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29681)
*Ryohei Oura,Georgios Fainekos,Hideki Okamoto,Bardh Hoxha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对未知马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），提出了一种基于概率提升（PR）因果性识别的学习方法，通过重启动MDP修改将PR因果性检查简化为两个条件可达性查询，并开发了基于双边值迭代的随时学习-检查算法，在实验上实现了可靠且快速的PR原因识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PR因果性识别方法依赖于MDP的修改和可达性概率，不适合学习场景：条件与无条件可达性概率之间的差距难以从转移样本中检测，且当转移概率未知时无法构造。

Method: 提出重启动（restart-based）MDP修改方法，将PR因果性检查简化为两个条件可达性查询，无需使用原始MDP的可达性值；基于双边值迭代开发了随时学习-检查算法，逐步将状态分类为因果、非因果或未决定。

Result: 证明了方法的正确性，建立了样本复杂度界，并在两个基准实验上验证了可靠且快速的PR原因识别。

Conclusion: 所提方法有效解决了未知MDP中PR因果性识别的学习问题，为MDP中因果推断提供了具有概率保证的学习框架。

Abstract: Probabilistic model checking for Markov decision processes (MDPs) provides quantitative guarantees, but often offers limited insight into why undesired outcomes occur. Probability-raising (PR) causality addresses this by identifying states whose visitation increases the probability of reaching designated states. Existing PR-cause identification methods, however, use MDP modifications not well-suited for learning: the gap between conditional and unconditional reachability probabilities can be hard to detect from transition samples, and construction requires reachability probabilities of the MDP, which are unavailable when transition probabilities are unknown. We study unknown MDPs and propose a learning approach with probabilistic guarantees for PR-cause identification. Our key ingredient is a restart-based MDP modification that reduces PR-cause checking to two conditional reachability queries without using reachability values of the original MDP. We prove correctness, establish sample-complexity bounds, and develop an anytime learning-and-checking algorithm based on two-sided value iteration that progressively classifies states as causal, non-causal, or undecided. Experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate reliable and fast identification of PR causes.

</details>


### [439] [Toward Secure and Reliable PDDL Formalization of Large Language Models with Planner-in-the-Loop Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29700)
*Jiamei Jiang,Jiajing Zhang,Feifei Mo,Linjing Li,Daniel Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NL-PDDL-Bench基准，用于评估从自然语言到PDDL规划规范的构建，并提出了一种基于规划器在环的优化框架，结合LoRA微调、DPO偏好优化和推理时规划器辅助修复，显著提升了规划成功率和计划一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在自主决策系统中进行形式化规范构建时，常常失败导致不可验证的决策、执行失败或不安全行为，现有研究缺乏可执行性和可验证性方面的系统评估与优化方法。

Method: 构建多领域NL-PDDL-Bench基准（含可执行性验证和物体数量控制的难度缩放）；提出规划器在环框架（利用验证器和规划器诊断信息进行局部编辑修正）；开发规划器引导优化配方（LoRA监督微调+离线规划器偏好对DPO+推理时规划器在环修复，训练中无需在线规划器调用）；提供统一评估套件（可解析性、可解性、规范相似性、计划级一致性）。

Result: 在多个代表性模型家族上的实验表明，该方法在规划器成功率和计划级一致性上取得显著提升，且在难度缩放和跨领域变化下展现出改进的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 外部可验证的形式化规范构建对于LLM在安全或安全敏感的规划系统中可靠部署具有重要价值。

Abstract: Planning often requires symbolic specifications that are both executable and verifiable. For large language models deployed in autonomous or decision-support systems, failures in such formalization may lead to unverifiable decisions, execution failures, or unsafe downstream behavior. We present NL-PDDL-Bench, a multi-domain benchmark for natural-language-to-PDDL specification construction with planner-verified executability and controlled difficulty scaling by object count. We further propose a planner-in-the-loop framework that uses validator and planner diagnostics to revise non-executable specifications through localized edits. Building on this infrastructure, we develop a planner-grounded optimization recipe that combines parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation supervised fine-tuning, offline planner-derived preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization, and inference-time planner-in-the-loop repair, without requiring online planner calls during training. We also provide a unified evaluation suite for parseability, solvability, specification similarity, and outcome-aware plan-level consistency against planner references. Experiments on representative model families show substantial gains in planner success and plan-level agreement, with improved robustness under difficulty scaling and cross-domain variation. These results highlight the value of externally verifiable formalization for reliable deployment of LLMs in safety- or security-sensitive planning systems. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/ibasicplan/NL-PDDL-Bench

</details>


### [440] [GUICrafter: Weakly-Supervised GUI Agent Leveraging Massive Unannotated Screenshots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29705)
*Sunqi Fan,Lingshan Chen,Runqi Yin,Qingle Liu,Yongming Rao,Meng-Hao Guo,Shi-Min Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GUICrafter提出了一种弱监督的GUI智能体训练方法，通过课程学习框架，先利用大量无标注截图学习视觉定位，再使用少量高质量数据通过强化学习校准模型，在仅使用UI-TARS 0.1%数据量的情况下达到同等甚至更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI智能体数据无法像自然语言数据那样直接从互联网大规模获取，人工标注成本高昂且难以规模化，导致现有GUI智能体跨设备泛化能力差、对细粒度GUI元素的视觉定位能力有限。

Method: 提出GUICrafter弱监督GUI智能体框架，采用两阶段课程学习：阶段1利用大量无标注截图和网页在GUI交互中学习视觉定位；阶段2使用少量高质量数据通过强化学习进行模型校准。

Result: GUICrafter在仅使用UI-TARS 0.1%数据量的情况下达到同等甚至更优性能；在相同标注数据量下，超越GUI-R1等所有先前方法。

Conclusion: 弱监督学习范式能有效降低GUI智能体对昂贵人工标注的依赖，通过课程学习框架可构建高性能的GUI智能体，代码、数据和模型已开源。

Abstract: Data, as the fundamental substrate of modern intelligence, has greatly driven the development of current foundation models. Naturally, researchers aim to extend this paradigm to the domain of GUI agents, hoping to build strong GUI agents through a similar paradigm. However, GUI agent data cannot be directly harvested from the internet, making it costly and difficult to collect at scale. As a result, current GUI agents suffer from poor cross-device generalization and limited visual grounding ability for fine-grained GUI elements. As an attempt to address data challenge in GUI agents, we propose GUICrafter, a weakly-supervised GUI agent leveraging massive unannotated screenshots to substantially reduce the reliance on expensive human annotations. GUICrafter explores a curriculum learning framework for training GUI agents through two progressive stages. First, the model learns visual grounding from large-scale unannotated screenshots and webpages, leveraging the rich contextual signals inherent in GUI interactions without human annotations. Then, in Stage 2, we leverage a small amount of high-quality data to calibrate the model via reinforcement learning. Experiments show that GUICrafter achieves competitive, or even superior, performance to advanced systems like UI-TARS while using only 0.1% of its data. Furthermore, under the same amount of annotated data, GUICrafter surpasses all previous methods such as GUI-R1. Code, data, and models are available at https://github.com/fansunqi/GUICrafter.

</details>


### [441] [DeepTrans Studio: Turning Expert Interventions into Shared Team Knowledge in Agentic Translation Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29727)
*Ziyang Lian,Qingya Zhang,Hao Wang,Huiwen Xiong,Qi Yang,Lingyi Meng,Xiaoyi Gu,Rui Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeepTrans Studio 是一个协作翻译平台，允许专业翻译团队在AI工作流中拦截节点、审核证据、修改AI输出，并将批准的决定保存到共享团队记忆中，使人工干预成为可重用、可追溯的知识而非一次性修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的翻译工具将人工修正视为孤立编辑，团队中一名成员的专业决策无法被捕获并作为可重用知识传递给其他成员，缺乏团队协作机制。

Method: 构建一个协作翻译工作空间，允许专业人员在智能体翻译工作流中拦截选定节点，审查证据，修改AI输出，并将批准的决定保存到共享团队记忆中，实现跨段落和跨成员的知识传播。

Result: 通过角色扮演演示，与会者以译者和审校者身份解决预设的术语和法律模态风险，验证决策如何传播到下游段落并作为可重用先例出现在队友工作空间中。

Conclusion: 该演示表明AI辅助工作中的人工干预可以成为共享的、可追溯的团队知识，而非一次性修正，从而提升团队翻译的一致性和效率。

Abstract: Professional translation is often a team-based process: translators, reviewers, and project managers must coordinate terminology, legal force, and accountability across documents. Yet many LLM-based translation tools treat human corrections as isolated edits. Expert decisions made in one segment or by one member are rarely captured as reusable knowledge for the rest of the team.
